questions.stem: Let S be the set of all real numbers x for which (x − 3)(x + 5) and (x − 3)(2x − 1) are equal. What is the sum of the numbers in S ?

questions.subskill: Equation that is quadratic in a square root
questions.stem: What value of x satisfies the equation x − √x = 6 ?

questions.subskill: Number of solutions of a circle-parabola system
questions.stem: The system of equations x² + y² = 25 and y = x² − 5 has how many ordered-pair solutions (x, y) ?

questions.subskill: Constant that gives a cubic exactly two distinct zeros
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 9x + c, where c is a negative constant. If f has exactly two distinct real zeros, what is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: Sum of the constants in a factored trinomial
questions.stem: The expression 6x² + 7x − 20 can be written as (ax + b)(cx + d), where a, b, c and d are integers and a and c are positive. What is the value of a + b + c + d ?

questions.subskill: Evaluating a product of exponential expressions from a known power
questions.stem: If 9ˣ = 5, what is the value of 27ˣ · 3⁻ˣ ?

questions.subskill: Value of x + 1/x from a quadratic equation
questions.stem: The number x satisfies x² − 5x + 1 = 0. What is the value of x + 1/x ?

questions.subskill: Combining two exponential decay terms
questions.stem: After a 200-milligram dose of a medicine, the amount remaining in the body t hours later is 200(0.8)ᵗ milligrams. A second 200-milligram dose is taken 3 hours after the first and decays the same way. To the nearest tenth of a milligram, how many milligrams of the medicine are in the body 5 hours after the first dose?

questions.subskill: Equal outputs at inputs two units apart
questions.stem: For the function f(x) = x² − 4x, the output at x = a equals the output at x = a + 2. What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Parameter that makes a rational equation have no solution
questions.stem: In the equation a/(x − 1) + 3 = (2x + 1)/(x − 1), a is a constant. For what value of a does the equation have no solution?

questions.subskill: Solving an exponential equation by factoring out a common power
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 5(3)^x. If f(t + 2) − f(t) = 360, what is the value of t ?

questions.subskill: Chained unit conversion with rounding up
questions.stem: A lawn fertilizer is applied at a rate of 2.5 pounds per 1,000 square feet and is sold only in 20-pound bags. What is the least number of bags needed to fertilize a field of 0.75 acre? (1 acre = 43,560 square feet)

questions.subskill: Median from a frequency table with an unknown frequency
questions.stem:
The frequency table shows how many times each value occurs in a data set.
Value | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5
Frequency | 4 | 7 | x | 6 | 3
What is the least value of x for which the median of the data set is 3 ?

questions.subskill: Percent change of a subgroup when the whole and the share both change
questions.stem: From 2020 to 2025, a town's population increased by 20%, and the percent of residents who recycle rose from 40% to 50%. By what percent did the number of residents who recycle increase from 2020 to 2025? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Square inscribed in a right triangle
questions.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths 6 and 8. A square is drawn inside the triangle so that two of its sides lie along the legs and the vertex of the square opposite the right angle lies on the hypotenuse. What is the side length of the square?

questions.subskill: Hypotenuse from a sine-cosine relationship
questions.stem: In a right triangle, the sine of one acute angle θ is 3 times the cosine of θ, and the shorter leg has length 2. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

questions.subskill: Angle formed by two angle bisectors in a triangle
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle A is 50°. The bisectors of angles B and C intersect at point P. What is the measure of angle BPC ?

questions.subskill: Price from an equal-cost relation and one known price
questions.stem: At a fair, 3 hot dogs and 2 drinks cost the same as 1 hot dog and 5 drinks. If a drink costs $2.40, what is the price of one hot dog?

questions.subskill: Slope recovered from how a vertical shift moves an intercept
questions.stem: The graph of a linear function f has an x-intercept at x = 6. The graph of g(x) = f(x) + 4 has an x-intercept at x = 8. What is the slope of the graph of f ?

questions.subskill: Least whole number satisfying a scaled linear inequality
questions.stem: Lena's savings, in dollars, w weeks from now will be 200 + 15w, and Omar's savings, in dollars, will be 350 − 10w. What is the least whole number of weeks w for which Lena's savings will be more than twice Omar's savings?

questions.subskill: Unknown total defined by a shortfall and a surplus
questions.stem: If each member of a club pays $12, the club will be $40 short of the cost of a trip. If each member pays $14, the club will have $26 more than the cost of the trip. What is the cost of the trip, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Line containing the vertices of a family of parabolas
questions.stem: For each value of the constant k, the graph of y = x² − 2kx + k² + 2k − 8 in the xy-plane is a parabola. The vertices of all these parabolas lie on which line?

questions.subskill: Percent growth over half a doubling period
questions.stem: A quantity doubles every 6 years. By what percent does the quantity increase every 3 years? Round your answer to the nearest tenth of a percent. (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Constant term from one irrational solution
questions.stem: One solution of the equation x² − 6x + c = 0, where c is a constant, is 3 + √5. What is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: Distance from a chord endpoint to the midpoint of its arc
questions.stem: In a circle with radius 10, chord AB has length 12. Point P is the midpoint of minor arc AB. What is the length of segment AP ?

questions.subskill: Linear cost model with one parameter changed by a percent
questions.stem: A caterer charges a fixed fee plus a cost per guest. An event with 40 guests costs $1,150, and an event with 65 guests costs $1,700. If the cost per guest increases by 10% and the fixed fee does not change, what will an event with 50 guests cost, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Quadrants of a line after slope and intercept switch roles
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = mx + b, where m and b are constants, has a negative slope and a positive y-intercept. Through which quadrant does the graph of y = bx + m NOT pass?

questions.subskill: Another solution of a linear equation from two known solutions
questions.stem: The points (2, 3) and (5, −1) are both solutions to the equation ax + by = c, where a, b, and c are nonzero constants. Which of the following points must also be a solution to the equation?

questions.subskill: Count of x-intercepts after a constant creates a repeated zero
questions.stem: The function p is defined by p(x) = (x − 1)(x + 2)(x − k), where k is a constant. If p(3) = 20, how many distinct x-intercepts does the graph of y = p(x) have in the xy-plane?

questions.subskill: Quadratic in a linear expression; sum of solutions in x
questions.stem: What is the sum of all solutions to the equation (2x − 1)² − 3(2x − 1) − 10 = 0 ?

questions.subskill: Population count range from a sample proportion and margin of error
questions.stem: A random sample of 250 of a school's 4,000 students were asked whether they walk to school; 35% of the sample said yes. The margin of error for this estimate is 6 percentage points. Based on these results, which of the following is a plausible number of students at the school who walk to school?

questions.subskill: Bounding the median of two combined lists
questions.stem: List A contains 9 numbers and has a median of 40. List B contains 9 numbers and has a median of 50. The two lists are combined into one list of 18 numbers. Which of the following must be true about the median of the combined list?

choices.D: It cannot be determined; it could be less than 40.

questions.subskill: Constant for which a point lies inside a circle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of x² + y² + 4x − 10y = k, where k is a constant, is a circle. The point (1, 2) lies inside the circle. Which of the following could be the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Perimeter of a right triangle from its hypotenuse and area
questions.stem: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 10 and an area of 20. What is the perimeter of the triangle?

questions.subskill: Missing table cell from a conditional probability, then the reverse conditional
questions.stem:
A survey classified each person by age and preferred news source.
News source | Under 30 | 30 or older
Podcasts | x | 66
Television | 48 | 126
If a person who prefers podcasts is chosen at random, the probability that the person is under 30 is 0.45. If a person under 30 is chosen at random, what is the probability that the person prefers podcasts?

questions.subskill: Common value consistent with two margins of error
questions.stem: Independent random polls estimated the percent of voters who support a measure in two cities. In City A the estimate was 54% with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. In City B the estimate was 47% with a margin of error of 5 percentage points. If the true percents of supporters in the two cities are in fact equal, which of the following is a plausible value of that common percent, based on the polls?

questions.subskill: Rate of change hidden in a standard-form model
questions.stem: The height H, in inches, and the age A, in years, of a sapling are related by the equation 3H − 8A = 54. According to this model, by how many inches does the sapling's height increase each year?

questions.subskill: Two travelers leaving at different times in opposite directions
questions.stem: Car A leaves a town at 1:00 p.m. and drives east at 40 miles per hour. Car B leaves the same town at 1:30 p.m. and drives west at 60 miles per hour. At what time will the cars be 270 miles apart?

questions.subskill: Expression for a cost with a rate change after a threshold
questions.stem: A gym membership costs $35 per month for the first 3 months and $28 per month after that. Which expression gives the total cost, in dollars, of n months of membership, where n ≥ 3 ?

questions.subskill: Maximum of a rational model by graphing
questions.stem: The concentration of a medicine in the blood t hours after a dose is modeled by C(t) = 60t/(t² + 9), where C(t) is in milligrams per liter and t ≥ 0. According to the model, what is the maximum concentration, in milligrams per liter?

questions.subskill: Number of zeros from the signs of a and c
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax² + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants, a < 0, and c > 0. How many distinct real zeros does f have?

choices.D: It cannot be determined without the value of b.

questions.subskill: Compound growth run backward to an earlier value
questions.stem: An investment earns 5% interest compounded annually. It is worth $2,000 now. To the nearest dollar, what was the investment worth 3 years ago, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Converting a per-area rate between metric units
questions.stem: A coating is applied at a rate of 0.4 gram per square centimeter. What is this rate in kilograms per square meter?

questions.subskill: Radius of an externally tangent circle from the distance between centers
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle with center (0, 0) has radius 5. A second circle has center (9, 12), touches the first circle at exactly one point, and lies outside the first circle. What is the radius of the second circle?

questions.subskill: Possible values from the triangle inequality with algebraic sides
questions.stem: A triangle has sides of lengths x, x + 3, and 2x − 1. Which of the following describes all possible values of x ?

questions.subskill: Solving a shifted, translated function equation from a table
questions.stem:
The function f is defined only for x = 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. The table gives all of its values.
x | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5
f(x) | 5 | 3 | 8 | 2 | 6
The function g is defined by g(x) = f(x + 1) − 2. For what value of x is g(x) = 6 ?

questions.subskill: Two counts from the effect of swapped prices
questions.stem: A theater sold 150 tickets, some adult and some student. Adult tickets cost $14 and student tickets cost $9. A cashier mistakenly charged $9 for each adult ticket and $14 for each student ticket and collected $150 more than the correct total. How many student tickets were sold?

questions.subskill: Bound on a constant from a value that is not a solution
questions.stem: In the inequality 3x − 7 < 2(x + k), k is a constant. If x = 5 is NOT a solution to the inequality, what is the greatest possible value of k ?

questions.subskill: Linear function from a functional equation
questions.stem: A linear function f satisfies f(2x) = 2f(x) + 7 for all values of x, and f(1) = 4. What is the value of f(3) ?

questions.subskill: Constant from an identity between a rational expression and a linear expression
questions.stem: The equation (x² + kx − 12)/(x − 2) = x + c is true for all values of x ≠ 2, where k and c are constants. What is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: First whole hour one exponential model exceeds another
questions.stem: Culture A starts with 2,000 bacteria and grows by 15% each hour. Culture B starts with 6,000 bacteria and grows by 6% each hour. After how many whole hours will culture A first have more bacteria than culture B?

questions.subskill: Exponents with related bases forming a linear system
questions.stem: If 4^a · 8^b = 2^12 and a − b = 1, what is the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Sum of parameter values that make two lines perpendicular
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the lines y = kx + 2 and y = (k − 5)x − 3, where k is a constant, are perpendicular. What is the sum of all possible values of k ?

questions.subskill: Group size from a joint and a conditional probability
questions.stem: In a survey of 600 adults, the probability that a randomly selected adult is a student and works part-time is 0.24. The probability that a randomly selected student works part-time is 0.6. How many of the surveyed adults are students?

questions.subskill: Percent price cut that keeps a smaller markup
questions.stem: A store prices an item 25% above its cost. During a sale, the store lowers the price so that it still makes a 10% profit on its cost. By what percent was the price lowered? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Triangle area from an arc length
questions.stem: Points A and B lie on a circle with center O and radius 8. The length of minor arc AB is 16π/3. The area of triangle AOB is k√3. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Volume of a box from its surface area
questions.stem: A closed rectangular box has a square base. The height of the box is 3 inches greater than the side length of the base. The total surface area of the box is 210 square inches. What is the volume of the box, in cubic inches?

questions.subskill: Distance recovered from a three-part linear fare, then a speed
questions.stem: A rideshare fare is $2.50 plus $1.75 per mile plus $0.40 per minute. A 15-minute ride cost $26.00. What was the average speed of the ride, in miles per hour?

questions.subskill: Unknown rate after a percent raise, compared across different hours
questions.stem: A tutor raised her hourly rate by 20%. At the new rate, 5 hours of tutoring cost $30 more than 4 hours of tutoring cost at the old rate. What is the tutor's new hourly rate?

questions.subskill: Choosing the half-plane that contains the origin
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, which of the following points lies on the same side of the graph of 4x − 3y = 12 as the origin?

questions.subskill: Distance from a round trip at two speeds and a total time
questions.stem: Kim drove from home to a lake at an average speed of 50 miles per hour and returned home on the same route at an average speed of 30 miles per hour. The round trip took 4 hours of driving. How far, in miles, is the lake from Kim's home?

questions.subskill: Vertical stretch that makes a shifted parabola touch the axis
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = k(x + 1)(x − 3), where k is a nonzero constant, and the function g is defined by g(x) = f(x) + 8. If the graph of y = g(x) in the xy-plane has exactly one x-intercept, what is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Nested radical rewritten as one rational exponent
questions.stem: If x > 0 and √(x√x) = 8, what is the value of x ?

questions.subskill: Sign conditions on coefficients from the vertex quadrant
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the vertex of the graph of y = x² + bx + c, where b and c are constants, lies in Quadrant IV. Which of the following must be true?

questions.subskill: Comparing yearly percent decrease of models with different periods
questions.stem: The value of one machine is modeled by f(t) = 800(0.95)^t dollars and the value of another is modeled by g(t) = 800(0.9)^(t/2) dollars, where t is the number of years since purchase. Which statement is true?

choices.A: Each value decreases by 5% per year.
choices.B: The value f decreases by a greater percent each year than g does.
choices.C: The value g decreases by 10% each year.
choices.D: The value g decreases by a greater percent each year than f does.

questions.subskill: Line of best fit after a change of units
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the price y, in dollars, of each of several snacks and its weight x, in ounces. The line of best fit is y = 2.5x + 10. If every price is rewritten in cents and the weights are unchanged, which equation is the line of best fit for the new data?

questions.subskill: Percent change in speed when pace improves
questions.stem: A runner's average pace improved from 8 minutes per mile to 7 minutes 30 seconds per mile. By approximately what percent did the runner's average speed increase?

questions.subskill: Liquid depth after transfer from a hemisphere to a cylinder
questions.stem: A bowl shaped like a hemisphere with an inside radius of 9 centimeters is full of water. All of the water is poured into an empty cylindrical glass with an inside radius of 6 centimeters that is tall enough to hold it. How deep, in centimeters, is the water in the glass?

questions.subskill: Segment length from similar triangles with a non-obvious correspondence
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, point D lies on side AC so that angle ABD has the same measure as angle ACB. If AB = 6 and AC = 9, what is the length of segment DC ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting a constant that divides the variable in a linear model
questions.stem: The amount of fuel G, in gallons, left in a car's tank after the car is driven m miles on a trip is given by G = 15 − m/28. What is the best interpretation of 28 in this context?

choices.A: The car travels 28 miles for each gallon of fuel it uses.
choices.B: The car's tank holds 28 gallons of fuel.
choices.C: The fuel in the tank decreases by 28 gallons for each mile driven.
choices.D: The car can travel 28 miles before the tank is empty.

questions.subskill: Range of an expression from two linear inequalities
questions.stem: If 3x + 5 ≤ 2x + 9 and x ≥ −1, which of the following is a possible value of 2x + 3 ?

questions.subskill: Slope hidden in a constant-difference condition
questions.stem: The graph of the linear function f in the xy-plane passes through the point (2, 9). The value of f(x) − 2x is the same for every value of x. What is the value of f(7) ?

questions.subskill: Total amount from two transfer conditions
questions.stem: If Ana gives Ben $20, they will have equal amounts of money. If instead Ben gives Ana $20, Ana will have twice as much money as Ben. How many dollars do Ana and Ben have together?

questions.subskill: Doubling time from an exponential model with base 4
questions.stem: A population is modeled by P(t) = 300 · 4^(t/10), where t is the number of years since the population was first measured. How many years does it take the population to double?

questions.subskill: Exponential function with an added constant through two points
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a · 2^x + b, where a and b are constants. If f(0) = 5 and f(3) = 19, what is the value of f(2) ?

questions.subskill: Maximum profit from a linear price model and a linear cost
questions.stem: A company can sell x units of a product when the price is p = 50 − 0.5x dollars per unit. The cost of producing x units is 10x + 200 dollars. What is the greatest possible profit, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Greatest probability bounded by the position of the median
questions.stem: A data set consists of 25 numbers and has a median of 40. If one number is chosen at random from the data set, what is the greatest possible probability that the number chosen is less than 40?

questions.subskill: Altitude to the hypotenuse from a sine value
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, sin A = 3/5, and AB = 25. Segment CD is the altitude from C to side AB. What is the length of CD ?

questions.subskill: Area ratio of circles from equal arcs at different central angles
questions.stem: A 40° arc of circle P has the same length as a 30° arc of circle Q. What is the ratio of the area of circle Q to the area of circle P ?

questions.subskill: Difference of two heights from two angles of elevation
questions.stem: From a point on level ground 50 meters from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top of the tower is 35°, and the angle of elevation to the top of an antenna on top of the tower is 41°. To the nearest meter, how long is the antenna?

questions.subskill: Recovering constants inside an absolute value inequality from its solution interval
questions.stem: In the inequality |2x − a| < b, a and b are positive constants. The solutions of the inequality are exactly the values of x with −1 < x < 5. What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Input at which a linear function equals its input
questions.stem: The linear function f satisfies f(1) = 5 and f(4) = −1. For what value of x is f(x) = x ?

questions.subskill: Coin counts from a count difference and an opposite value difference
questions.stem: A jar holds only quarters and dimes. There are 5 more dimes than quarters, but the total value of the dimes is $1.30 less than the total value of the quarters. How many dimes are in the jar?

questions.subskill: Unknown entries of a table forced by linearity with unequal steps
questions.stem:
The table shows three values of the linear function f.
x | 1 | 3 | 7
f(x) | 4 | k | 2k
What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Price from a fixed budget and a change in the number of items
questions.stem: With $120, a shopper could buy 2 more shirts if each shirt cost $5 less. What is the price of one shirt, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Negative exponent applied to a sum
questions.stem: For all positive values of x and y, which of the following is equivalent to (x⁻¹ + y⁻¹)⁻¹ ?

questions.subskill: Y-coordinate of the intersection of two exponential graphs
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = 2ˣ and y = 8 · 2⁻ˣ intersect at the point (a, b). What is the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Rule of a function from its value at a shifted input
questions.stem: The function f satisfies f(x − 1) = x² + 2x for all values of x. Which of the following defines f ?

questions.subskill: Comparing means and standard deviations from frequency tables
questions.stem:
Two data sets each contain 10 values, using only the values 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. The frequency tables give all of the data.
Value | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5
Set A frequency | 1 | 2 | 4 | 2 | 1
Set B frequency | 4 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 4
Which of the following is true?

choices.A: The means are equal, and the standard deviation of set A is greater.
choices.B: The mean of set B is greater, and the standard deviation of set B is greater.
choices.C: The means are equal, and the standard deviations are equal.
choices.D: The means are equal, and the standard deviation of set B is greater.

questions.subskill: Edge of a cube from mass and density
questions.stem: A solid cube is made of aluminum, which has a density of 2.7 grams per cubic centimeter. The mass of the cube is 1 kilogram. To the nearest tenth of a centimeter, what is the length of an edge of the cube?

questions.subskill: Opposite endpoint of a diameter from a circle equation
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle has the equation x² + y² − 8x + 2y − 8 = 0. The point (1, 3) is one endpoint of a diameter of the circle. What are the coordinates of the other endpoint of that diameter?

questions.subskill: Sector area from a radian angle and the sector perimeter
questions.stem: A sector of a circle has a central angle of 2 radians. The perimeter of the sector, which consists of two radii and an arc, is 36. What is the area of the sector?

questions.subskill: Linear model with a delayed start and a unit conversion
questions.stem: A printer needs a 30-second warm-up after its start button is pressed and then prints 18 pages per minute. Which equation gives the number of pages p printed t seconds after the button is pressed, for t ≥ 30 ?

questions.subskill: Counting integers in the overlap of two absolute value inequalities
questions.stem: How many integers x satisfy both |x − 5| < 4 and |x − 10| ≤ 4 ?

questions.subskill: Original price when a price rise and a sales drop leave revenue unchanged
questions.stem: Last season a theater sold 300 tickets for each show at a single price. This season the ticket price is $2 higher, the theater sells 30 fewer tickets per show, and the revenue per show is unchanged. What was last season's ticket price, in dollars?

questions.subskill: System from two shared resources
questions.stem: Each batch of recipe A uses 3 eggs and 2 cups of milk, and each batch of recipe B uses 2 eggs and 3 cups of milk. A cook made some batches of each recipe and used exactly 24 eggs and 26 cups of milk. How many batches of recipe B did the cook make?

questions.subskill: Factor theorem fixes a constant, then the remaining zeros
questions.stem: The polynomial p is defined by p(x) = x³ + kx² − 16x + 48, where k is a constant. If x − 3 is a factor of p(x), what is the greatest zero of p ?

questions.subskill: X-intercept of an absolute value graph after finding its stretch factor
questions.stem: For the function f(x) = a|x − 3| + 8, where a is a constant, f(1) = 4. The graph of y = f(x) crosses the x-axis at two points. What is the x-coordinate of the point that is farther to the right?

questions.subskill: Constant from an identity in which square terms cancel
questions.stem: For all values of x, (ax + 5)² − (ax − 5)² = 60x, where a is a constant. What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Quadratic from a symmetry identity and a minimum value
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² + bx + c, where b and c are constants. If f(x) = f(6 − x) for all values of x and the minimum value of f is −4, what is the value of f(−1) ?

questions.subskill: Converting liters per 100 kilometers to miles per gallon
questions.stem: A car uses 8 liters of fuel for every 100 kilometers it is driven. Using 1 mile = 1.609 kilometers and 1 gallon = 3.785 liters, what is the car's fuel efficiency, to the nearest whole number of miles per gallon?

questions.subskill: Group mean from a weighted combined mean with linked group means
questions.stem: The mean score of the members of group A is 10 points higher than the mean score of the members of group B. Group A has 3 times as many members as group B. The mean score of the two groups combined is 85. What is the mean score of group B?

questions.subskill: Cofunction identity turns a trig relation into a linear equation
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, and sin A = 3 cos B − 1. What is the value of sin A ?

questions.subskill: Constant from a condition relating two solutions
questions.stem: In the equation 5x − 2 = 3x + k, k is a constant. If k is increased by 6, the solution of the equation doubles. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Linear function from its intercept and a sign condition
questions.stem: For the linear function f, f(0) = −6, and f(x) > 0 exactly when x > 4. What is the value of f(10) ?

questions.subskill: Writing an inequality from a described boundary and side
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the solutions to an inequality are all the points on or above the line that passes through (0, 3) and (6, 0). Which of the following is the inequality?

questions.subskill: Two speeds from meeting and catch-up conditions
questions.stem: Two trains start 300 miles apart. If they travel toward each other, they meet after 2 hours. If instead they travel in the same direction, the faster train catches up with the slower one after 10 hours. What is the speed of the faster train, in miles per hour?

questions.subskill: Area of a rectangle from two perimeter conditions
questions.stem: A rectangle has sides of lengths a and b and a perimeter of 40. If side a were 4 units longer and side b were half as long, the perimeter would be 34. What is the area of the original rectangle?

questions.subskill: Y-intercept of a cubic built from crossing and touching behavior
questions.stem: The graph of y = p(x), where p is a polynomial of degree 3 with leading coefficient 1, crosses the x-axis at x = −2, touches the x-axis without crossing it at x = 4, and has no other x-intercepts. What is the y-intercept of the graph?

questions.subskill: Difference between a value and the minimum when the constant cancels
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 2x² − 16x + k, where k is a constant. How much greater is f(0) than the minimum value of f ?

choices.D: It cannot be determined without the value of k.

questions.subskill: Mean minus median from a percent frequency distribution
questions.stem: In a survey, every household reported having 0, 1, 2, or 3 cars: 25% have 0 cars, 40% have 1 car, 25% have 2 cars, and 10% have 3 cars. How much greater is the mean number of cars per household than the median number of cars per household?

questions.subskill: Cylinder volume from its lateral area and height
questions.stem: The label on a cylindrical can covers the entire curved side of the can and has an area of 60π square centimeters. The can is 6 centimeters tall. What is the volume of the can, in cubic centimeters?

questions.subskill: Least apex angle of an isosceles triangle from one exterior angle
questions.stem: One exterior angle of an isosceles triangle measures 100°. What is the least possible measure, in degrees, of the angle formed by the triangle's two congruent sides?

questions.subskill: Slope forced by two points with swapped coordinates
questions.stem: The linear function f satisfies f(0) = 10, f(3) = k, and f(k) = 3, where k is a constant and k ≠ 3. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Solution of a system that does not depend on an unknown coefficient
questions.stem: In the system of equations 3x + 5y = 11 and 6x + ky = 22, k is a constant and k ≠ 10. What is the value of x in the solution (x, y) of the system?

questions.subskill: Least integer parameter from a condition on a system solution
questions.stem: In the system of equations x + y = 10 and x − y = k, k is a constant. If the solution (x, y) of the system satisfies x > 2y, what is the least possible integer value of k ?

questions.subskill: Additional time at a constant drain rate from fractions of an unknown amount
questions.stem: The water in a tank drains at a constant rate. Ten minutes after draining starts, the tank holds 3/4 of the water it started with. How many more minutes will it take until the tank holds 2/5 of the water it started with?

questions.subskill: Maximum of a quadratic model after finding a coefficient from the vertex
questions.stem: The height, in feet, of a fountain's stream is modeled by h(x) = −0.5x² + bx + 2, where x is the horizontal distance, in feet, from the nozzle and b is a constant. The stream is highest at x = 4. What is the greatest height of the stream, in feet?

questions.subskill: Linear versus exponential models through the same two points
questions.stem: A linear function L and an exponential function E, where E(x) = a · bˣ with b > 0, satisfy L(0) = E(0) = 50 and L(2) = E(2) = 98. What is the value of L(1) − E(1) ?

questions.subskill: Change in height from a radical model solved twice
questions.stem: The distance d, in miles, to the horizon for an observer h feet above the ground is approximately d = √(1.5h). An observer at a lookout sees the horizon 6 miles away. About how many feet higher must the observer climb to see the horizon 9 miles away?

questions.subskill: Unknown input from two residuals sharing an actual value
questions.stem: A line of best fit for a data set is y = 1.8x + 12. The data point with x = 15 has a residual of 4. Another data point has the same y-value as that point and a residual of −5. What is the x-value of the second data point?

questions.subskill: Inner arc length from the difference of two concentric arcs
questions.stem: Two runners run counterclockwise on circular paths with the same center, one with radius 30 meters and the other with radius 36 meters. Both start on the same ray from the center and stop on another such ray, so both sweep through the same central angle. The runner on the outer path runs 12 meters farther than the runner on the inner path. How many meters does the runner on the inner path run?

questions.subskill: Inscribed angle that intercepts the major arc
questions.stem: Points A, B, and C lie on a circle with center O. Central angle AOB measures 110°, and point C lies on minor arc AB. What is the measure of angle ACB ?

questions.subskill: Original total from probabilities before and after a removal
questions.stem: A bag contains only red and blue marbles. The probability of drawing a red marble at random is 2/5. After 6 red marbles are removed, the probability of drawing a red marble at random is 1/4. How many marbles were in the bag originally?

questions.subskill: Positive solution of a quadratic with an irrational coefficient
questions.stem: What is the positive solution to the equation x² − 2√3x − 9 = 0 ?

questions.subskill: Original price from a discount, a coupon and the final share
questions.stem: A store takes 15% off the original price of a coat and then subtracts a $6 coupon. The final price is 80% of the original price. What was the original price, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Linear function value from a sum and a difference of outputs
questions.stem: For the linear function f, f(6) − f(2) = 10 and f(2) + f(6) = 30. What is the value of f(0) ?

questions.subskill: Parameter from the area of a triangle formed by two lines and a vertical line
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the lines y = 2x + 1 and y = −x + 7 and the vertical line x = k, where k > 2, form a triangle with an area of 24 square units. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting the point in point-slope form in context
questions.stem: The number of members y of a club x weeks after it was formed is modeled by the equation y − 50 = 4(x − 10). What is the best interpretation of 50 in this context?

choices.A: The number of members 10 weeks after the club was formed
choices.B: The number of members when the club was formed
choices.C: The number of members gained during the first 10 weeks
choices.D: The number of members gained each week

questions.subskill: Cylinder whose volume equals its surface area
questions.stem: A closed right circular cylinder has a height equal to its diameter. The number of cubic units in its volume equals the number of square units in its total surface area. What is the radius of the cylinder?

questions.subskill: Height where a falling ball passes a rising drone
questions.stem: A ball's height, in meters, t seconds after it is thrown upward is h(t) = −5t² + 30t. A drone that is 20 meters high at t = 0 rises at 5 meters per second, so its height is 5t + 20 meters. At what height, in meters, does the ball pass the drone while the ball is falling?

questions.subskill: Comparing linear and percent increases in successive years
questions.stem: Towns A and B each have 12,500 residents now. Town A's population will increase by 500 people each year, and town B's population will increase by 4% each year. Which statement correctly compares the two towns' increases during the next year and during the year after it?

choices.A: During the first year, the increases are equal; during the second year, town B's increase is greater.
choices.B: During the first year, the increases are equal; during the second year, the increases are equal again.
choices.C: During the first year, town B's increase is greater; during the second year, town B's increase is greater.
choices.D: During the first year, town A's increase is greater; during the second year, town A's increase is greater.

questions.subskill: Simplifying a rational expression by factoring twice
questions.stem: For x ≠ 2, which of the following is equivalent to (x⁴ − 16)/(x − 2) ?

questions.subskill: Ratio of remaining masses for two half-lives
questions.stem: Substance A has a half-life of 4 hours, and substance B has a half-life of 6 hours. Two samples, one of each substance, start with equal masses. After 12 hours, what is the ratio of the mass of substance A remaining to the mass of substance B remaining?

questions.subskill: Percent change in predictions from a line of best fit
questions.stem: A line of best fit y = 1.5x + 30 models a plant's height y, in centimeters, x days after a study began. According to the model, by approximately what percent does the predicted height increase from day 10 to day 20 ?

questions.subskill: Conditional probability with a complement after finding an overlap
questions.stem: Of the 80 students in a grade, 30 take chemistry, 45 take biology, and 10 take neither. If a student who does not take biology is selected at random, what is the probability that the student takes chemistry?

questions.subskill: Angle in nested isosceles triangles
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, AB = AC and the measure of angle C is 40°. Point D lies on side BC so that AD = BD. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle DAC ?

questions.subskill: Starting price from a constant dollar increase equal to a percent
questions.stem: A stock's price rose by $1.50 each day for 8 days. Its price after the 8 days was 30% greater than its starting price. What was the starting price, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Joining fee when one condition is an average
questions.stem: A gym charges a one-time joining fee plus the same fee each month. A member who stays 4 months pays $230 in all. A member who stays 10 months pays an average of $35 per month, counting the joining fee. What is the joining fee, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Solving a lens formula with linked variables
questions.stem: For a lens, 1/f = 1/p + 1/q, where f is the focal length, p is the distance from the object to the lens, and q is the distance from the image to the lens, all in centimeters. For a lens with f = 12, an object is placed so that p = 3q. What is the value of q ?

questions.subskill: Area of a circle as a function of its circumference
questions.stem: Which of the following functions gives the area A of a circle in terms of its circumference C ?

questions.subskill: Exponential model from a rebound percent
questions.stem: A ball is dropped from a height of 12 meters. After each bounce, it rises to 75% of the height of its previous peak. Which function gives the peak height h(n), in meters, after the nth bounce?

questions.subskill: Polynomial value from intersections with a horizontal line
questions.stem: The function p is defined by p(x) = x³ + bx² + cx + d, where b, c, and d are constants. The graph of y = p(x) intersects the line y = 5 at x = 1, x = 2, and x = 3. What is the value of p(4) ?

questions.subskill: Splitting a trip between two fuel rates
questions.stem: On a 360-kilometer trip, a car used 25.2 liters of fuel. The car uses 9 liters per 100 kilometers in city driving and 6 liters per 100 kilometers in highway driving. How many kilometers of the trip were city driving?

questions.subskill: Population estimate from a conditional percent inside a sample
questions.stem: A random sample of 150 of the 6,000 households in a town found that 40 of the sampled households have a dog, and 45% of those 40 households also have a cat. Based on the sample, which is the best estimate of the number of households in the town that have both a dog and a cat?

questions.subskill: Angle between radii to the points of tangency
questions.stem: Segments PA and PB are tangent to a circle with center O at points A and B, respectively. Angle APB measures 50°. What is the measure of angle AOB ?

questions.subskill: Fraction of a triangle’s area from a ratio on one side and a midpoint
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, point D lies on side BC so that BD : DC = 2 : 3, and point E is the midpoint of segment AD. The area of triangle ABE is what fraction of the area of triangle ABC ?

questions.subskill: Counting whole-number values between a derived lower bound and a stated cap
questions.stem: Mia works exactly 40 hours each week: x hours tutoring at $16.50 per hour and the rest at a café at $12 per hour. She wants to earn at least $552 each week, and the tutoring center allows her to tutor at most 25 hours per week. How many different whole-number values of x are possible?

questions.subskill: Regular price from a per-unit discount and an add-on
questions.stem: A gas station takes $0.12 off the regular price of each gallon for members. A member bought 12.5 gallons of gas and a $3.25 snack and paid $49.00 in all. What is the regular price of a gallon of gas?

questions.subskill: Difference of two constants fixed by an intersection x-coordinate
questions.stem: The functions f(x) = 3x + b and g(x) = −x + c, where b and c are constants, have graphs that intersect at a point with an x-coordinate of 2. What is the value of c − b ?

questions.subskill: Input whose output is the average of two outputs of a linear function
questions.stem: For the function f(x) = 3x − 9, what value of x satisfies f(x) = (f(2) + f(10))/2 ?

questions.subskill: Lesser zero of a quadratic profit model with a non-monic leading coefficient
questions.stem: A shop's weekly profit, in hundreds of dollars, when an item is priced at x dollars is modeled by P(x) = −2x² + 25x − 63. What is the lowest price, in dollars, at which the profit is $0 ?

questions.subskill: Cost from a scaled recipe and a mass unit conversion
questions.stem: A recipe that serves 12 people uses 1.5 pounds of beef. Beef costs $8.80 per kilogram, and 1 kilogram = 2.2 pounds. What is the cost of the beef needed to serve 30 people?

questions.subskill: Comparing two measures of spread from five-number summaries
questions.stem:
Daily sales at two stores are summarized below.
Store A: minimum 12, first quartile 20, median 26, third quartile 31, maximum 48
Store B: minimum 15, first quartile 18, median 27, third quartile 35, maximum 40
Which statement is true?

choices.A: Store B's interquartile range is greater, and store B's range is smaller.
choices.B: Store B's interquartile range is greater, and store B's range is greater.
choices.C: Store B's interquartile range is smaller, and store B's range is greater.
choices.D: Store B's interquartile range is smaller, and store B's range is smaller.

questions.subskill: Area of a rhombus with a 60° angle from its shorter diagonal
questions.stem: A rhombus has an interior angle of 60°, and its shorter diagonal has a length of 10. What is the area of the rhombus?

questions.subskill: Range of usage where one plan beats two others
questions.stem: Print shop A charges $12 plus $0.08 per page, shop B charges $27 plus $0.05 per page, and shop C charges $0.11 per page with no fee. For which numbers of pages p is shop A strictly cheaper than both of the other shops?

questions.subskill: Linear model with a known point that is not the intercept
questions.stem: The air temperature drops 2.5°F for every 1,000 feet of altitude gained. At an altitude of 4,000 feet the temperature is 58°F. According to this model, what is the temperature, in °F, at an altitude of 10,500 feet?

questions.subskill: Constants in a linear inequality from its solution set
questions.stem: In the inequality ax + 5 ≥ 3x + b, a and b are constants. If the solutions of the inequality are exactly the values of x with x ≤ 4, which of the following could be the values of a and b ?

questions.subskill: Intersection of two unknown linear functions from their difference
questions.stem: The linear functions f and g satisfy f(0) − g(0) = 8 and g(10) − f(10) = 12. For what value of x is f(x) = g(x) ?

questions.subskill: Y-intercept of a horizontally shifted quadratic from zeros and an intercept
questions.stem: The quadratic function f has zeros at x = −4 and x = 6, and its graph crosses the y-axis at y = −12. The function g is defined by g(x) = f(x − 3). At what y-value does the graph of y = g(x) cross the y-axis?

questions.subskill: Negative rational exponent after solving a rational-exponent equation
questions.stem: If x > 0 and x^(5/2) = 32, what is the value of x^(−3/2) ?

questions.subskill: Greatest difference from two squared equations
questions.stem: The numbers x and y satisfy (x − 3)² = 16 and (y + 2)² = 9. What is the greatest possible value of x − y ?

questions.subskill: Comparing changes in mean and median under unequal increases
questions.stem: A data set consists of 10 different numbers. Each of the 9 smallest numbers is increased by 5, and the largest number is increased by 25. By how much does the increase in the mean exceed the increase in the median?

questions.subskill: Data from a streaming rate through two unit changes
questions.stem: A video streams at 4.5 megabits per second. Using 8 bits = 1 byte and 1 gigabyte = 1,000 megabytes, how many gigabytes of data does streaming a 2-hour video use?

questions.subskill: Diagonal of a square that is a fixed amount longer than a side
questions.stem: The diagonal of a square is 3 units longer than a side of the square. What is the length of the diagonal?

questions.subskill: Perimeter of an octagon cut from a rectangle
questions.stem: An octagon is formed by cutting an isosceles right triangle with legs of length 4 from each corner of a 16-by-10 rectangle. What is the perimeter of the octagon?

questions.subskill: Time from a cooling model after isolating the exponential part
questions.stem: The temperature, in degrees Celsius, of a cup of tea t minutes after it is poured is modeled by T(t) = 22 + 64(0.5)^(t/10). How many minutes after it is poured is the tea at 38°C ?

questions.subskill: Least integer constant from a strict bound on a solution
questions.stem: In the equation 5x − a = 2x + 12, a is a constant. If the solution of the equation is greater than 7, what is the least possible integer value of a ?

questions.subskill: Linear function from a nested input
questions.stem: For the linear function f, f(2) = 5 and f(f(2)) = 14. What is the value of f(0) ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting a constant in a quadratic area model
questions.stem: The area A, in square meters, of a rectangle with width w meters and a fixed perimeter is given by A(w) = w(50 − w). What does the number 50 represent in this context?

choices.A: The sum of the rectangle's length and width, in meters
choices.B: The perimeter of the rectangle, in meters
choices.C: The greatest possible area of the rectangle, in square meters
choices.D: The length of the rectangle, in meters

questions.subskill: Time at which a rational concentration model reaches a value
questions.stem: The concentration of a drug in a patient's blood t hours after a dose is modeled by C(t) = 50t/(t + 4) milligrams per liter, for t ≥ 0. At what time t, in hours, is the concentration 30 milligrams per liter?

questions.subskill: Ratio of two conditional probabilities from a table without totals
questions.stem:
A gym classified each of its members by plan and preferred workout time. The table gives all the members.
Plan | Morning | Afternoon | Evening
A | 20 | 35 | 45
B | 30 | 18 | 12
The probability that a randomly chosen Plan B member prefers morning is how many times the probability that a randomly chosen Plan A member prefers morning?

questions.subskill: Volume of a pyramid whose height comes from a lateral edge
questions.stem: A pyramid has a rectangular base that is 8 by 6, and each of its four slanted edges (from a base vertex to the top) has length 13. What is the volume of the pyramid?

questions.subskill: Greatest center y-coordinate from two points and a radius
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle with radius 13 passes through the points (−4, 2) and (20, 2). What is the greatest possible y-coordinate of the center of the circle?

questions.subskill: Area of a sector of a ring with a degree angle
questions.stem: Two circles have the same center, and their radii are 9 and 12. Two radii of the larger circle form a 60° central angle. The region between the two circles and inside this angle has an area of kπ. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Equal values of two linear models with different reference years
questions.stem: The number of members of club A is modeled by A(t) = 320 + 12t, where t is the number of years after 2010. The number of members of club B is modeled by B(u) = 500 − 8u, where u is the number of years after 2015. In what year do the two clubs have the same number of members?

questions.subskill: Capacity from a percent relation inside a volume total
questions.stem: A large bottle holds 50% more than a small bottle. Four small bottles and three large bottles together hold 6.8 liters. How many liters does one large bottle hold?

questions.subskill: Ratio of variables from a homogeneous linear equation
questions.stem: If 3(2a − b) = 4(a + b) and b ≠ 0, what is the value of a/b ?

questions.subskill: Linear relation between two temperature scales from two fixed points
questions.stem: On thermometer scale A, water freezes at 20° and boils at 180°. On scale B, water freezes at −10° and boils at 90°. Readings on the two scales are related linearly. When scale B reads 0°, what does scale A read?

questions.subskill: Inverting a power-law proportion
questions.stem: For planets orbiting a star, the square of a planet's orbital period is proportional to the cube of its average distance from the star. Planet Q's orbital period is 8 times planet P's. Planet Q's average distance from the star is how many times planet P's?

questions.subskill: Recovering an exponential function from successive differences
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a · bˣ, where a and b are positive constants. If f(0) − f(1) = 12 and f(1) − f(2) = 9, what is the value of f(3) ?

questions.subskill: Squaring a binomial with opposite half exponents
questions.stem: Which of the following is equal to (√x + 1/√x)² for all positive values of x ?

questions.subskill: Signed residuals: where the line overestimates most
questions.stem: A line of best fit for a data set is y = −1.5x + 40. For which of the following data points does the line overestimate the actual y-value by the greatest amount?

questions.subskill: New water depth when a solid sticks out of the water
questions.stem: A rectangular tank has a base that is 50 centimeters by 40 centimeters and contains water 15 centimeters deep. A solid metal cube with edges of 20 centimeters is placed flat on the bottom of the tank. What is the new depth of the water, in centimeters?

questions.subskill: Apex angle of an isosceles triangle from parallel lines
questions.stem: Lines ℓ and m are parallel. Point A lies on line ℓ, and points B and C lie on line m. In triangle ABC, AB = AC, and one of the angles formed by line ℓ and segment AB measures 55°. What is the measure of angle BAC ?

questions.subskill: Line equation from a translation that maps the line to itself
questions.stem: A line in the xy-plane passes through the point (2, 3). For every point (x, y) on the line, the point (x + 4, y − 6) is also on the line. Which of the following is an equation of the line?

questions.subskill: Coefficient of a third line through the intersection of two others
questions.stem: The graphs of 2x + y = 7, x − y = 2, and kx + 3y = 13 in the xy-plane all pass through one common point. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Ticket counts when revenues, not counts, are in a given ratio
questions.stem: A theater sold 630 tickets: orchestra seats at $45 each and balcony seats at $30 each. The revenue from orchestra seats was twice the revenue from balcony seats. How many balcony tickets were sold?

questions.subskill: Two constants of a rational function from two values
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of y = (ax + 6)/(x + b), where a and b are constants, passes through the points (0, 2) and (2, 3). What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Area of the square formed by changing a rectangle’s sides
questions.stem: A rectangle has an area of 525 square meters. If its length were decreased by 10 meters and its width increased by 10 meters, the result would be a square. What would be the area of that square, in square meters?

questions.subskill: Least integer constant that keeps a rational function defined everywhere
questions.stem: The function h is defined by h(x) = 1/(x² − 6x + k), where k is an integer constant. If h(x) is defined for every real number x, what is the least possible value of k ?

questions.subskill: Conditional probability where the mean defines the group
questions.stem:
The table shows the number of pets owned by each of the 40 students in a class.
Number of pets | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
Number of students | 12 | 15 | 8 | 4 | 1
A student is chosen at random from the students who own more than the mean number of pets for the class. What is the probability that the chosen student owns at least 3 pets?

questions.subskill: Individual rate from a percent relation and a combined rate
questions.stem: Rachel types 20% faster than Tom. Working at the same time, they type a total of 2,200 words in 10 minutes. How many words per minute does Tom type?

questions.subskill: Cylinder height from a cone of equal volume with a scaled radius
questions.stem: A right circular cone and a right circular cylinder have equal volumes. The radius of the cone is twice the radius of the cylinder, and the height of the cone is 12. What is the height of the cylinder?

questions.subskill: Squared trig expression from a tangent value
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and tan A = 2. What is the value of sin²A − cos²A ?

questions.subskill: How moving one value between groups changes both means
questions.stem: The students in class A have a mean test score of 78, and the students in class B have a mean test score of 83. One student, who scored 80, moves from class B to class A. Which of the following statements is true?

choices.A: Class A's mean increases, and class B's mean increases.
choices.B: Class A's mean increases, and class B's mean decreases.
choices.C: Class A's mean increases, and class B's mean stays the same.
choices.D: Class A's mean decreases, and class B's mean increases.

questions.subskill: Solving a linear inequality with a negative literal coefficient
questions.stem: In the inequality ax − 6 > 2a, a is a constant and a < 0. Which of the following is equivalent to the inequality?

questions.subskill: Least parameter that makes a system of three inequalities nonempty
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the system of inequalities y ≤ x + k, y ≥ 3 − x, and x ≤ −2, where k is a constant, has at least one solution. What is the least possible value of k ?

questions.subskill: Least production level for profit to reach a percent of cost
questions.stem: A company's cost to make n phone cases is 2,000 + 8n dollars, and it sells every case for $18. Profit is revenue minus cost. What is the least number of cases the company must make and sell for its profit to be at least 25% of its cost?

questions.subskill: Linear function where y = f(x) and y = 2f(x) intersect
questions.stem: The graph of the linear function f in the xy-plane passes through the point (3, 7). The graphs of y = f(x) and y = 2f(x) intersect at a point with x-coordinate 5. What is the value of f(0) ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting the compounding frequency in an exponential model
questions.stem: The balance, in dollars, of an account t years after it is opened is modeled by B(t) = 2,500(1 + 0.04/4)^(4t). What is the best interpretation of the 4 that multiplies t in the exponent?

choices.A: The balance increases by 4% each year.
choices.B: The balance is modeled for 4 years.
choices.C: Each time interest is added, the balance increases by 4%.
choices.D: Interest is added to the account 4 times each year.

questions.subskill: Greatest production level with average cost at most a value
questions.stem: A bakery's cost, in dollars, to make x cakes is C(x) = 0.5x² + 10x + 200. What is the greatest number of cakes for which the average cost per cake, C(x)/x, is at most $35 ?

questions.subskill: Volume rate in gallons from a depth rate over an area
questions.stem: A sprinkler system waters a 2,000-square-foot lawn at a rate equal to 0.6 inch of water depth per hour. Using 1 cubic foot = 7.48 gallons, how many gallons of water per hour does the system deliver?

questions.subskill: Rectangle area from a diagonal and its angle with a side
questions.stem: A diagonal of a rectangle has a length of 14 and makes a 30° angle with the longer side of the rectangle. What is the area of the rectangle?

questions.subskill: Whole-triangle area from a sub-triangle area and the altitude relation
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, and CD is the altitude to hypotenuse AB. If AD = 4 and the area of triangle ACD is 16, what is the area of triangle ABC ?

questions.subskill: Flight duration and time-zone offset from two trips
questions.stem: A flight leaves City A at 8:00 a.m. City A time and lands in City B at 11:00 a.m. City B time. The return flight leaves City B at 1:00 p.m. City B time and lands in City A at 9:00 p.m. City A time. Because of winds, the return flight takes 1 hour longer than the outgoing flight. How many hours does the return flight take?

questions.subskill: Carrying a tolerance through a trim-and-divide transformation
questions.stem: A machine cuts metal rods whose lengths L, in centimeters, satisfy |L − 80| ≤ 0.6. From each rod, 2 centimeters are trimmed off one end, and the rest is cut into 4 pieces of equal length p centimeters. Which inequality gives all possible values of p ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting a product of constants in a taxed linear model
questions.stem: The total cost C, in dollars, of a banquet for n guests, including sales tax, is given by C = 1.08(250 + 18n). What is the best interpretation of 1.08(18) in this context?

choices.A: The amount, in dollars, by which the total cost increases for each additional guest, including tax
choices.B: The amount, in dollars, of sales tax charged for each additional guest
choices.C: The total cost, in dollars, of a banquet for one guest, including tax
choices.D: The amount, in dollars, by which the total cost increases for each additional guest, before tax

questions.subskill: Clock time when a constant rate reaches a target level
questions.stem: A phone's battery charge drops at a constant rate while a video plays. At 9:40 a.m. the charge is 76%, and at 11:10 a.m. it is 58%. At this rate, at what time will the charge be 20% ?

questions.subskill: Recovering an input from a linear model through a distance and time
questions.stem: The speed of sound in air, v meters per second, is modeled by v = 331 + 0.6T, where T is the air temperature in degrees Celsius. An observer hears thunder 5 seconds after seeing a lightning flash 1,745 meters away. Assuming the light arrives instantly, what is the air temperature, in degrees Celsius, according to the model?

questions.subskill: Photo side from a border-to-photo area ratio
questions.stem: A square photograph is mounted on a square mat so that a border 2 inches wide surrounds the photograph on all sides. The area of the border is 1.25 times the area of the photograph. What is the side length, in inches, of the photograph?

questions.subskill: Counting integer production levels with positive quadratic profit
questions.stem: A company sells x units of a product each week at a price of (80 − 2x) dollars per unit, so its weekly revenue is x(80 − 2x) dollars. Its weekly cost is 10x + 300 dollars. For how many integer values of x is the weekly profit positive?

questions.subskill: Domain of a volume model implied by its context
questions.stem: An open box is made from a 30-inch-by-30-inch sheet of cardboard by cutting a square with side x inches from each corner and folding up the sides. The volume of the box is V(x) = x(30 − 2x)² cubic inches. Which describes all values of x for which this model makes sense?

questions.subskill: Printing time from a volume rate through cubed unit conversions
questions.stem: A 3-D printer deposits plastic at a constant rate of 12 cubic millimeters per second. At this rate, how many hours will it take to print an object that uses 0.54 liter of plastic? (1 liter = 1,000 cubic centimeters, and 1 centimeter = 10 millimeters)

questions.subskill: Comparing a sum of two circle areas with one larger circle
questions.stem: A pizzeria sells round pizzas with diameters of 14 inches and 10 inches, all of the same thickness. How many more square inches of pizza are in two 10-inch pizzas than in one 14-inch pizza?

questions.subskill: Ratio of volumes of the two cylinders rolled from one sheet
questions.stem: A rectangular sheet of paper 8.5 inches by 11 inches can be rolled into an open cylinder (no top or bottom) in two ways: by joining its 8.5-inch edges, which makes a cylinder 8.5 inches tall, or by joining its 11-inch edges, which makes a cylinder 11 inches tall. The volume of the 8.5-inch-tall cylinder is how many times the volume of the 11-inch-tall cylinder?

questions.subskill: Pace per mile from a metric race time
questions.stem: A runner finished a 5-kilometer race in 22 minutes 30 seconds. Using 1 mile = 1.6 kilometers, what was her average pace, in minutes per mile?

questions.subskill: Least possible profit from prices that each lie in an interval
questions.stem: A grocer pays between $1.80 and $2.50 per kilogram for apples, inclusive, and sells them for between $3.00 and $3.60 per kilogram, inclusive. What is the least possible profit, in dollars, on 50 kilograms of apples?

questions.subskill: Equal gaps in a row with end margins
questions.stem: A web page is 1,280 pixels wide. A single row of 6 images, each 180 pixels wide, spans the page with a 40-pixel margin at the left and right edges of the page, and the gaps between neighboring images are all equal. How many pixels wide is each gap?

questions.subskill: Combining a per-mile cost with a per-hour wage through speed
questions.stem: A courier's van costs $0.18 per mile for fuel and maintenance, and the courier is paid $20 per hour of driving. If the van averages 50 miles per hour, what is the total of these costs, in dollars per mile driven?

questions.subskill: Shared force in two springs joined end to end
questions.stem: Spring A is 12 centimeters long with no load and stretches 0.5 centimeter for each newton of force. Spring B is 15 centimeters long with no load and stretches 0.3 centimeter for each newton of force. The springs are hooked end to end, and a weight pulls on both with the same force F newtons, making the total length 47 centimeters. What is the value of F ?

questions.subskill: Inverse-square law with a change of distance
questions.stem: The illuminance from a small lamp is inversely proportional to the square of the distance from the lamp. A light sensor 4 meters from the lamp reads 360 lux. If the sensor is moved to 3 meters from the lamp, what will it read, in lux?

questions.subskill: Maximum height after finding a constant from the landing time
questions.stem: A diver's height above the water, in feet, t seconds after leaving a platform is given by h(t) = −16t² + 16t + k, where k is a constant. The diver enters the water at t = 2. What is the diver's greatest height above the water, in feet?

questions.subskill: Surface area of a fixed-volume cylinder as a function of radius
questions.stem: A closed cylindrical can has a volume of 500π cubic centimeters. Which function gives the can's total surface area S, in square centimeters, in terms of its radius r ?

questions.subskill: Speed from a quadratic stopping-distance model
questions.stem: A driving guide estimates the stopping distance d, in feet, of a car traveling v miles per hour as d = v + v²/20. According to the guide, at what speed, in miles per hour, is the stopping distance 120 feet?

questions.subskill: Subgroup and overall rates pointing in opposite directions
questions.stem:
The table gives all the patients at two clinics, by the severity of their illness and whether they recovered.
Clinic | Mild, recovered | Mild, did not | Severe, recovered | Severe, did not
A | 95 | 5 | 120 | 180
B | 270 | 30 | 35 | 65
Which statement about the recovery rates is true?

choices.A: Clinic A's rate is higher for mild cases, higher for severe cases, and higher for all patients combined.
choices.B: Clinic B's rate is higher for mild cases, higher for severe cases, and lower for all patients combined.
choices.C: Clinic B's rate is higher for mild cases, lower for severe cases, and higher for all patients combined.
choices.D: Clinic A's rate is higher for mild cases, higher for severe cases, and lower for all patients combined.

questions.subskill: Population estimate from sample plots with an area conversion
questions.stem: Ecologists counted 38 orchids in randomly placed sample plots with a total area of 50 square meters in a meadow with an area of 1.2 hectares (1 hectare = 10,000 square meters). Based on the sample, which is the best estimate of the number of orchids in the meadow?

questions.subskill: Gap from a corner to a circle tangent to both walls
questions.stem: A circular rug with a diameter of 8 feet lies flat in a corner of a rectangular room and touches both walls that meet at the corner. To the nearest hundredth of a foot, what is the distance from the corner to the nearest point on the edge of the rug?

questions.subskill: Image height in a pinhole camera with mixed units
questions.stem: In a pinhole camera, light from the top and bottom of an object passes through a tiny hole and forms an inverted image on a screen, so the object and the image form similar triangles. A tree 6 meters tall is 15 meters from the pinhole, and the screen is 8 centimeters behind the pinhole. How tall, in centimeters, is the image of the tree?

questions.subskill: Re-expressing a model’s input over a different time window
questions.stem: A rule estimates the air temperature T, in degrees Fahrenheit, as T = n + 40, where n is the number of chirps a cricket makes in 14 seconds. Which equation gives T in terms of c, the number of chirps the cricket makes per minute?

questions.subskill: Second time two walkers are a given distance apart
questions.stem: On a straight trail, Ana starts at the 3-mile marker and walks toward higher-numbered markers at 2.5 miles per hour. At the same moment, Ben starts at the 12-mile marker and walks toward lower-numbered markers at 3.5 miles per hour. How many minutes after they start will Ana and Ben be exactly 2 miles apart for the second time?

questions.subskill: Change in break-even quantity when the price rises
questions.stem: A food truck's daily costs are $315 plus $1.50 for each taco it makes, and it sells every taco it makes. If the price of a taco is raised from $4.00 to $5.00, by how many tacos does the number needed to break even (revenue equal to cost) decrease?

questions.subskill: Distance fallen during a one-second window
questions.stem: An object dropped from a tall cliff falls 4.9t² meters in the first t seconds. During the one-second interval from t = k to t = k + 1, it falls 34.3 meters. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Round-trip time against a current as a rational expression
questions.stem: A boat travels d miles upstream and then d miles back downstream. Its speed in still water is s miles per hour, and the river's current is c miles per hour, where s > c. Which expression gives the total travel time, in hours?

questions.subskill: Quadratic from a minimum stated as an inequality
questions.stem: For the quadratic function f, f(x) ≥ 3 for all values of x, f(2) = 3, and f(0) = 7. What is the value of f(5) ?

questions.subskill: Greatest value of an expression under a linear constraint
questions.stem: If x + y = 12, what is the greatest possible value of xy + 4x ?

questions.subskill: Solving a square-root growth model
questions.stem: The carbon stored in a young forest plot, in metric tons, t years after planting is modeled by S(t) = 100 + 40√t. According to the model, how many years after planting will the plot store 260 metric tons of carbon?

questions.subskill: New average speed from a time difference
questions.stem: A cyclist completed a 40-kilometer time trial at an average speed of 36 kilometers per hour. A second cyclist finished the same course 2 minutes 40 seconds faster. What was the second cyclist's average speed, in kilometers per hour?

questions.subskill: Percent change in a density when both quantities change
questions.stem: From 2018 to 2024, the number of birds in a nature reserve increased by 12%, and land added to the reserve increased its area by 40%. By what percent did the number of birds per square kilometer change?

questions.subskill: Rate of rise of a level in a cylinder with a unit conversion
questions.stem: Corn is poured into an empty cylindrical grain bin with an inside radius of 2 meters at a constant rate of 0.45 cubic meter per minute, and the top of the corn is kept level. Which of the following is closest to the rate, in centimeters per minute, at which the level of the corn rises?

questions.subskill: Capacity of a prism with a trapezoid cross section
questions.stem: A water trough is a prism 3 meters long whose cross section is an isosceles trapezoid with a bottom edge of 40 centimeters, a top opening of 70 centimeters, and slanted sides of 25 centimeters each. How many liters does the trough hold when full? (1 liter = 1,000 cubic centimeters)

questions.subskill: Input where a miscalibrated linear reading is a stated percent of the truth
questions.stem: A kitchen scale is miscalibrated: when an object with a true mass of m grams is placed on it, the scale reads 0.96m + 12 grams. For an object of what true mass, in grams, is the reading exactly 2% less than the true mass?

questions.subskill: Re-expressing a linear model with a new base year
questions.stem: The number of electric vehicles registered in a county, in thousands, is modeled by y = 3.2(x − 2010) + 45, where x is the year and 2010 ≤ x ≤ 2024. Which equation gives the same model in terms of t, the number of years since 2015?

questions.subskill: Equal estimated times for two routes under a two-variable rule
questions.stem: A hiking guide estimates the time T, in hours, of a hike as T = d/5 + a/600, where d is the distance in kilometers and a is the total ascent in meters. Route A to a summit is 10 kilometers long with 900 meters of ascent, and route B is 7 kilometers long. For what total ascent, in meters, would route B have the same estimated time as route A?

questions.subskill: Balance condition summing products on one side
questions.stem: A seesaw balances when, on each side, the sum of each person's mass times that person's distance from the pivot is the same. A 30-kilogram child sits 2 meters from the pivot, and a 20-kilogram child sits 1.2 meters from the pivot on the same side. How far from the pivot, in meters, must a 48-kilogram adult sit on the other side to balance them?

questions.subskill: Interpreting a simplified coefficient when the total is fixed
questions.stem: A juice bar makes a 12-liter blend from x liters of juice A, which costs $2.40 per liter, and the rest juice B, which costs $1.50 per liter. The cost of the blend, in dollars, is C = 0.9x + 18. What is the best interpretation of 0.9 in this context?

choices.A: The increase, in dollars, in the cost of the blend for each liter of juice B replaced by a liter of juice A
choices.B: The increase, in dollars, in the cost of the blend for each additional liter added to the blend
choices.C: The cost, in dollars, of each liter of juice A that is used in the blend
choices.D: The cost, in dollars, of the 12-liter blend if it contains only juice B

questions.subskill: Time for one leg when two leg speeds are linked by a ratio
questions.stem: In a triathlon practice, Lee swam 1 kilometer and then biked 30 kilometers. Lee's average biking speed was 10 times Lee's average swimming speed, and the swim and the bike ride together took 2 hours. How many minutes did the bike ride take?

questions.subskill: Height of a parabolic cable built from a vertex and two equal points
questions.stem: A suspension-bridge cable hangs in the shape of a parabola between two towers 100 meters apart. The cable is attached 30 meters above the road at each tower, and its lowest point, midway between the towers, is 10 meters above the road. How many meters above the road is the cable at a point 20 meters horizontally from one tower?

questions.subskill: Speed at which a quadratic consumption model reaches a percent above its minimum
questions.stem: For speeds v from 40 to 80 miles per hour, the fuel a car uses, in gallons per mile, is modeled by g(v) = 0.00005(v − 55)² + 0.03. To the nearest whole number, at what speed greater than 55 miles per hour does the car use 25% more fuel per mile than it uses at 55 miles per hour?

questions.subskill: Base perimeter from dividing a volume polynomial by the height
questions.stem: A closed box has a volume of V(x) = x³ + 7x² + 14x + 8 cubic inches and a height of x + 1 inches, where x > 0. Its base is a rectangle whose length and width are x + a and x + b inches, where a and b are constants. Which expression gives the perimeter, in inches, of the base?

questions.subskill: Height of a rotating point using cosine and a raised center
questions.stem: A Ferris wheel has a diameter of 50 meters, and its lowest point is 2 meters above the ground. As the wheel turns, a car moves from the lowest point through an angle of 60° about the center of the wheel. How many meters above the ground is the car then?

questions.subskill: Writing a time-lagged relation between two functions
questions.stem: At every moment, the temperature in Town B is 5 degrees higher than the temperature in Town A was 2 hours earlier. If A(t) gives the temperature in Town A t hours after midnight, which expression gives the temperature in Town B t hours after midnight?

questions.subskill: Percent change of a square-root formula when two inputs grow
questions.stem: A formula estimates a person's body surface area, in square meters, as √(hw/3,600), where h is height in centimeters and w is mass in kilograms. If a growing child's height and mass each increase by 10%, by what percent does the estimated body surface area increase?

questions.subskill: Area of a triangle formed by a parabola's intercepts
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of y = (x − 3)² − 16 crosses the x-axis at points A and B and crosses the y-axis at point C. What is the area of triangle ABC?

questions.subskill: Length of a thin sheet from mass, density, and cross section
questions.stem: A roll of aluminum foil has a mass of 324 grams. The foil is 30 centimeters wide and 0.0016 centimeter thick, and aluminum has a density of 2.7 grams per cubic centimeter. How many meters long is the foil on the roll? (1 meter = 100 centimeters)

questions.subskill: Total from percents all based on one ingredient
questions.stem: In a bread recipe, the masses of water, salt, and yeast are 65%, 2%, and 1% of the mass of the flour, respectively. A batch of dough made of only these four ingredients has a mass of 1,008 grams. What is the mass, in grams, of the water?

questions.subskill: Mass of a product needed to raise a concentration
questions.stem: A swimming pool holds 40,000 liters of water, and a chlorine level of 1 part per million (ppm) means 1 milligram of chlorine per liter of water. A chlorine product is 75% chlorine by mass. How many grams of the product must be added to raise the pool's chlorine level from 1.5 ppm to 3 ppm? (1 gram = 1,000 milligrams)

questions.subskill: Probability for a randomly chosen person when counts are given by group
questions.stem: At a school, every student is in exactly one of 9 classes: 4 classes have 10 students each, 3 classes have 20 students each, and 2 classes have 30 students each. If one student at the school is chosen at random, what is the probability that the student is in a class of 30 students?

questions.subskill: Areas of two rectangles with equal diagonals and different ratios
questions.stem: Two television screens each have a 50-inch diagonal. One has a width-to-height ratio of 4 : 3, and the other has a width-to-height ratio of 16 : 9. To the nearest square inch, how much greater is the area of the 4 : 3 screen than the area of the 16 : 9 screen?

questions.subskill: Inner radius when a ring and the hole have equal areas
questions.stem: A metal pipe is a hollow cylinder with an outer radius of 5 centimeters. The volume of metal in the pipe equals the volume of the hollow space inside it. To the nearest hundredth of a centimeter, what is the inner radius of the pipe?

questions.subskill: Finding and correcting the one entry that breaks linearity
questions.stem:
A quantity y is known to be a linear function of x. A student recorded the values below, and exactly one of the y-values was recorded incorrectly.
x: 1, 4, 6, 9, 13
y: 5, 14, 21, 29, 41
What is the correct value of the incorrect entry?

questions.subskill: Distance from the gap between two arrival times
questions.stem: After an earthquake, P waves travel through the ground at about 6 kilometers per second and S waves at about 3.5 kilometers per second. A seismograph station records the first P wave 20 seconds before the first S wave. How far, in kilometers, is the station from the earthquake?

questions.subskill: Total mileage from a bill with a per-day allowance
questions.stem: A rental company charges $35 per day for a car, and each day of the rental includes 100 miles of driving. Every mile beyond the total included mileage costs $0.25. The total charge for a 4-day rental was $210. How many miles was the car driven?

questions.subskill: Total time for a rate that changes at a threshold
questions.stem: An electric car charges at 2 percentage points per minute until its battery reaches 80%, and then at 0.5 percentage point per minute. How many minutes does it take to charge the battery from 20% to 100%?

questions.subskill: Substituting one linear rule into another in context
