questions.stem: A shipping service charges C = 4.50 + 0.80w dollars to ship a package that weighs w pounds. A box packed with b books weighs w = 1.5 + 0.6b pounds. Which expression gives the shipping cost, in dollars, of a box packed with b books?

questions.subskill: Proportion that holds only on a shifted temperature scale
questions.stem: At constant pressure, the volume of a gas is proportional to its temperature measured in kelvins, where K = C + 273 and C is the temperature in degrees Celsius. A balloon has a volume of 2.0 liters at 27°C. At what temperature, in degrees Celsius, will its volume be 2.2 liters?

questions.subskill: Percent cap on total payments after a unit conversion
questions.stem: A lender requires that a borrower's total monthly debt payments, including a new mortgage payment, be at most 36% of the borrower's gross monthly income. Kim's gross annual income is $78,000, and her other monthly debt payments total $500. What is the greatest monthly mortgage payment for which Kim can qualify?

questions.subskill: Maximum of a quadratic built from two equal values
questions.stem: A company's weekly profit, in dollars, when it sells a product at a price of p dollars is P(p) = −40p² + bp + c, where b and c are constants. The weekly profit is $2,250 when p = 6 and also when p = 14. What is the maximum possible weekly profit?

questions.subskill: Building a perimeter quadratic from a parabola
questions.stem: A rectangle has two vertices on the x-axis and the other two vertices on the parabola y = 16 − x², above the x-axis. What is the greatest possible perimeter of the rectangle?

questions.subskill: Solving a rational dose rule at two values
questions.stem: Young's rule estimates a child's dose of a medicine as (adult dose) × a/(a + 12), where a is the child's age in years. By this rule, a child's dose is 1/4 of the adult dose at one age and 3/7 of the adult dose at an older age. How many years older is the second age?

questions.subskill: Comparing two outputs of a rational cost model
questions.stem: A city estimates that the cost, in thousands of dollars, of removing p percent of the litter along a river is C(p) = 120p/(100 − p), for 0 ≤ p < 100. The cost of removing 80% of the litter is how many times the cost of removing 40%?

questions.subskill: Fixed-area pen against a wall: choosing between two roots
questions.stem: A farmer uses 60 meters of fencing for three sides of a rectangular pen; the fourth side is a long barn wall. If the pen's area is 400 square meters, what is the greatest possible length, in meters, of the side parallel to the barn?

questions.subskill: Axis of symmetry from a shift that reflects the zeros
questions.stem: The quadratic function f has two distinct real zeros. The zeros of the function g, defined by g(x) = f(x + 5), are the opposites of the zeros of f. What is the x-coordinate of the vertex of the graph of f?

questions.subskill: Recovering the constants of a shifted square root
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = √(x − a) + b, where a and b are constants. The graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane passes through the points (5, 3) and (13, 5). What is the value of f(29)?

questions.subskill: Reciprocal solutions of a quadratic with equal outer coefficients
questions.stem: In the equation ax² + bx + a = 0, a and b are nonzero constants. If r is a real solution of the equation, which of the following must also be a solution?

questions.subskill: Mean after dropping the high and low scores
questions.stem: In a competition, each performance is scored by five judges. The highest and the lowest of the five scores are dropped, and the final score is the mean of the remaining three. Four of the judges gave a performance scores of 6.0, 7.5, 8.0 and 9.5, and its final score was 8.0. What score did the fifth judge give?

questions.subskill: Remaining distance when one runner finishes
questions.stem: In a 10-mile race, Ana runs at a constant pace of 6 minutes per mile and Bea runs at a constant pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per mile. To the nearest hundredth of a mile, how far from the finish line is Bea when Ana finishes?

questions.subskill: Estimating a count from two densities over shares of an area
questions.stem: A rally fills a rectangular plaza 120 meters by 80 meters. Organizers estimate a density of 2.5 people per square meter in the 40% of the plaza nearest the stage and 1 person per square meter in the rest of the plaza. Based on these estimates, how many people are in the plaza?

questions.subskill: Sharing a fixed resource between two usage rates
questions.stem: A printer's toner cartridge can print 3,000 pages at 5% page coverage, and the amount of toner used for a page is proportional to its coverage. After printing 600 pages at 12% coverage, how many more pages at 5% coverage can the cartridge print?

questions.subskill: Billing threshold from a cube-root inequality
questions.stem: A courier bills each package by the greater of its actual weight and its dimensional weight, where dimensional weight, in kilograms, is the package's volume in cubic centimeters divided by 5,000. A package is a cube and has an actual weight of 9 kilograms. What is the least whole-number edge length, in centimeters, for which the package is billed by its dimensional weight?

questions.subskill: Common chord of two circles: considering both positions
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, circle A has center (0, 0) and radius 17, and circle B has center (28, 0) and radius r. The circles intersect at exactly two points, and the distance between those points is 30. What is the greatest possible value of r?

questions.subskill: Range of areas from a length tolerance
questions.stem: The side of a square tile is measured as 10 centimeters, and the true side length is within 0.2 centimeter of the measured length. What is the difference, in square centimeters, between the greatest and least possible true areas of the tile?

questions.subskill: Slope of a tangent from the origin to an off-center circle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line through the origin with a positive slope is tangent to the circle (x − 5)² + y² = 9. What is the slope of the line?

questions.subskill: First whole year past a threshold under linear depreciation with salvage value
questions.stem: A company buys a machine for $48,000 and depreciates it linearly: its book value drops by the same amount each year until it reaches its salvage value of $6,000 at the end of 12 years. At the end of how many whole years will the book value first be less than half of the purchase price?

questions.subskill: Two chained round-ups from a ratio and a capacity
questions.stem: A school is taking 180 students on a field trip. There must be at least 1 adult chaperone for every 8 students, and each bus can hold at most 50 people (students and adults). What is the least number of buses needed?

questions.subskill: Sum-and-difference system with three exclusive groups
questions.stem: In a customer survey, every respondent chose exactly one of satisfied, neutral, or dissatisfied. Of the respondents, 15% chose neutral, and the percent who chose satisfied was 41 percentage points greater than the percent who chose dissatisfied. What percent of the respondents chose satisfied?

questions.subskill: Order amount that matches a free-shipping threshold
questions.stem: An online store charges shipping of $5 plus 8% of the order amount on orders under $75 and ships orders of $75 or more for free. To the nearest cent, what order amount under $75 has the same total cost (order amount plus shipping) as a $75 order?

questions.subskill: Ratio of two exponential models (real purchasing power)
questions.stem: From 2010 to 2020, Ana's salary increased by 2% each year, and the prices of the goods she buys increased by 6% each year. The purchasing power of her salary (the amount of goods it can buy) in 2020 was what percent of its purchasing power in 2010, to the nearest tenth of a percent?

questions.subskill: Maximum gap between a linear and a quadratic position
questions.stem: A car traveling at a constant 24 meters per second passes a parked police car. At that moment the police car starts from rest, and t seconds later it has traveled 1.5t² meters. What is the greatest distance, in meters, between the two cars before the police car catches up?

questions.subskill: Per-unit rate under a fractional power law
questions.stem: According to one model, an animal's daily energy need is proportional to m^(3/4), where m is the animal's mass. Animal B has 81 times the mass of animal A. According to the model, animal B's daily energy need per kilogram of body mass is what fraction of animal A's?

questions.subskill: Quotient of exponential expressions in context
questions.stem: A sound's intensity, in watts per square meter, is 10^((L − 120)/10), where L is the sound level in decibels. A leaf blower at 100 decibels is how many times as intense as a dishwasher at 70 decibels?

questions.subskill: Quotient of rational expressions that collapses to a constant
questions.stem: For x > 3, which expression is equivalent to (x² − 9)/(x² + 6x + 9) ÷ (x − 3)/(2x + 6)?

questions.subskill: Meeting time of a growing and a decaying population
questions.stem: The number of plants of an invasive species in a wetland doubles every 2 years, while the number of plants of a native species halves every 6 years. Currently, the native species is 16 times as numerous as the invasive species. If these trends continue, in how many years will the two species be equally numerous?

questions.subskill: Scaled-input equation that reduces to a linear equation
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² + 3x. For what value of x is f(2x) = 4f(x) − 18?

questions.subskill: Composing a sphere volume with a linearly growing radius
questions.stem: A spherical balloon is inflated so that its radius, starting from 0, increases at a constant rate of 2 centimeters per second. Which function gives the volume V, in cubic centimeters, of the balloon t seconds after inflation begins?

questions.subskill: Ratio of distances on a number line with two cases
questions.stem: On a number line, point P is twice as far from 10 as it is from 1. What is the sum of all possible coordinates of P?

questions.subskill: Direction of error for a miscalibrated odometer
questions.stem: A car's odometer counts how many times the wheels turn and assumes tires 25 inches in diameter, but the car has tires 26 inches in diameter. When the odometer shows that the car has traveled 100 miles, how many miles has the car actually traveled?

questions.subskill: Extra fuel cost per hour saved, independent of trip length
questions.stem: A car gets 30 miles per gallon at 60 miles per hour and 24 miles per gallon at 75 miles per hour, and gasoline costs $3.60 per gallon. For a highway trip of any length, the extra fuel cost of driving at 75 miles per hour instead of 60 is the same for each hour of driving time saved. What is that cost, in dollars per hour saved?

questions.subskill: Cone volume from a height and the slope angle
questions.stem: A conical pile of sand has a height of 3 meters, and its sloping side makes a 30° angle with the level ground. What is the volume, in cubic meters, of the pile?

questions.subskill: Area of a triangle with an obtuse included angle
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, AB = 8, AC = 10, and the measure of angle A is 150°. What is the area of triangle ABC?

questions.subskill: Right-triangle sides from a cosine and a difference
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and cos A = 0.6. The hypotenuse is 10 units longer than the shorter leg. What is the area of triangle ABC?

questions.subskill: Second isosceles triangle with equal legs and equal area
questions.stem: An isosceles triangle with two sides of length 5 and a base of length 6 has the same area as a different isosceles triangle whose two equal sides also have length 5. What is the length of the base of the second triangle?

questions.subskill: Counting equal step heights between two inclusive bounds
questions.stem: A staircase must rise a total of 108 inches, and every step (riser) must be the same height. The building code requires each riser to be at least 6 inches and at most 7.5 inches high. How many different numbers of steps are possible?

questions.subskill: Same-slope linear formulas: what equal outputs imply about inputs
questions.stem: A shoe-size chart uses S = 3L − 22 for men's sizes and S = 3L − 20.5 for women's sizes, where L is the length of the foot in inches. If a man and a woman wear the same numerical shoe size, which statement is true?

choices.A: The man's foot is 0.5 inch longer.
choices.B: The man's foot is 1.5 inches longer.
choices.C: The woman's foot is 0.5 inch longer.
choices.D: The woman's foot is 1.5 inches longer.

questions.subskill: Fuel inequality with a reserve given as time
questions.stem: A small airplane burns 8 gallons of fuel per hour in flight. Before one flight it holds 42 gallons. It uses 2 gallons while taxiing before takeoff, and it must land with enough fuel for at least 45 more minutes of flight. What is the greatest possible flight time, in minutes?

questions.subskill: Exponential outputs from a product of two outputs
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a · bˣ, where a and b are positive constants. If f(2) · f(4) = 144 and f(5) = 48, what is the value of f(1)?

questions.subskill: Angles of two pulleys linked by a belt
questions.stem: A belt connects a pulley with a radius of 30 centimeters to a pulley with a radius of 12 centimeters, and the belt does not slip. When the larger pulley turns through an angle of 2π/3 radians, through what angle, in radians, does the smaller pulley turn?

questions.subskill: Trigonometric ratios with an extraneous root
questions.stem: In a right triangle, angle A is one of the acute angles, sin A = (x − 3)/17, and cos A = (x + 4)/17, where x is a constant. What is the value of tan A?

questions.subskill: Solution of a system after a substitution maps it onto a known system
questions.stem: The system ax + by = c and dx + ey = f, where a, b, c, d, e and f are constants, has exactly one solution, (2, 5). What is the solution (x, y) of the system a(x − 3) + 2by = c and d(x − 3) + 2ey = f ?

questions.subskill: New x-intercept after scaling a line's coefficients
questions.stem: The graph of y = ax + b in the xy-plane, where a and b are nonzero constants, has an x-intercept at (6, 0). What is the x-coordinate of the x-intercept of the graph of y = 3ax + 2b ?

questions.subskill: Average cost under a two-tier price
questions.stem: A print shop charges $0.12 per page for each of the first 500 pages of an order and $0.08 per page for each page after the first 500. For one order, the average cost per page was $0.09. How many pages were in the order?

questions.subskill: Recovering two linear functions from combinations
questions.stem: The linear functions f and g satisfy f(x) + g(x) = 7x + 1 and f(x) − 2g(x) = x + 13 for all values of x. Which of the following defines f ?

questions.subskill: Difference of two unknowns from subtracted equations, with unit conversion
questions.stem: At a market, a bag of 4 peaches and 3 plums weighs 1.15 kilograms, and a bag of 2 peaches and 5 plums weighs 0.95 kilogram. Every peach has the same weight, and every plum has the same weight. How many grams more does a peach weigh than a plum?

questions.subskill: Output change from a percent change in the input
questions.stem: A theater estimates that the number of tickets it sells for a show is n = 1,500 − 15p, where p is the ticket price in dollars. According to the estimate, if the price is raised 20% from $40, by how many tickets does the number sold decrease?

questions.subskill: Solving for an expression as a single unknown
questions.stem: If (3/5)(4x + 7) + 2 = (1/5)(4x + 7) + 10, what is the value of 4x + 7 ?

questions.subskill: Eliminating a shared variable between two models
questions.stem: During a descent, a hiker's elevation E, in meters, t hours after leaving a summit is E = 2,400 − 300t, and the air temperature T, in degrees Celsius, at the hiker's location is T = 8 + 1.8t. Which equation gives T in terms of E ?

questions.subskill: Converting a compound inequality between temperature scales
questions.stem: A vaccine must be stored at temperatures from 36°F to 46°F, inclusive. Temperatures are related by F = 1.8C + 32, where F is in degrees Fahrenheit and C is in degrees Celsius. Which inequality gives, to the nearest tenth of a degree, the storage temperatures in degrees Celsius?

questions.subskill: Difference of two unknowns from a slope condition
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line with slope 3 passes through the points (a, b) and (b, a + 6), where a and b are constants and a ≠ b. What is the value of b − a ?

questions.subskill: Greatest possible median after adding a value
questions.stem: A data set consists of 9 numbers and has a median of 48. The number 50 is added to the data set. What is the greatest possible median of the 10 numbers?

questions.subskill: Number of zeros from two means
questions.stem: Each of 50 students reported the number of books they read over the summer, and the mean of the 50 reports was 2.4 books. Among the students who read at least one book, the mean was 3.0 books. How many of the students read no books?

questions.subskill: Percent change of a difference
questions.stem: In 2023, a company's costs were 75% of its revenue. From 2023 to 2024, the company's revenue increased by 10% and its costs increased by 8%. By what percent did the company's profit (revenue minus costs) increase?

questions.subskill: Missing table cell from equal conditional and overall probabilities
questions.stem:
The table gives all the shoppers in a survey, classified by age and by where they usually shop.
Under 40: online 72, in store 48
40 or older: online x, in store 120
If a shopper under 40 is selected at random, the probability that the shopper shops online is equal to the probability that a shopper selected at random from all the shoppers in the table shops online. What is the value of x ?

questions.subskill: Weight of snow from depth ratio and density
questions.stem: Fresh snow covers a 1,500-square-foot flat roof to a depth of 18 inches. When this snow melts, the water is 1/10 as deep as the snow was. Water weighs 62.4 pounds per cubic foot. What is the weight, in pounds, of the snow on the roof?

questions.subskill: Time-lapse scale between two time units
questions.stem: A time-lapse camera records a flower garden so that 6 hours of real time play as 45 seconds of video. In the video, a flower takes 18 seconds to open. How many minutes did the flower take to open in real time?

questions.subskill: Successive percent increases with a known difference in amounts
questions.stem: A club's membership increased by 20% during its first year and by 25% during its second year. The number of members added during the second year was 300 more than the number added during the first year. How many members did the club have at the start of the first year?

questions.subskill: Initial value of an exponential model with a shifted input
questions.stem: The number of subscribers to an app t months after its launch is modeled by S(t) = 1,200(1.15)^(t − 4), for 0 ≤ t ≤ 24. According to the model, to the nearest whole number, how many subscribers did the app have at launch?

questions.subskill: Matching numerators over a factored quadratic denominator
questions.stem: For all x other than 1 and −2, a/(x − 1) + b/(x + 2) = (5x + 1)/(x² + x − 2), where a and b are constants. What is the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Rationalizing a denominator that contains a variable
questions.stem: For x > 0, which expression is equivalent to x/(√(x + 9) − 3) ?

questions.subskill: Two different mechanisms that give exactly three distinct zeros
questions.stem: The polynomial p is defined by p(x) = (x² − 9)(x² + kx + 4), where k is a constant. What is the sum of all positive values of k for which p has exactly three distinct real zeros?

questions.subskill: Shape condition on the triangle formed by a parabola's vertex and intercepts
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of y = x² − 10x + k, where k is a constant, crosses the x-axis at two points. These two points and the vertex of the graph are the vertices of an equilateral triangle. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Sum of solutions when one branch is tangent
questions.stem: What is the sum of all solutions to the equation |x² − 8x| = 16 ?

questions.subskill: Slope of the chord through two parabola intersections
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = x² + 2x − 5 and y = −x² + 6x + 11 intersect at two points. What is the slope of the line that passes through these two points?

questions.subskill: Building a function from a verbal chain of operations
questions.stem: A function f takes an input, adds 2 to it, squares the result, and then subtracts 9. Which of the following defines f ?

questions.subskill: Simplifying a complex fraction with a difference of squares
questions.stem: For x ≠ 0, x ≠ 1, and x ≠ −1, which expression is equivalent to (1 − 1/x)/(1 − 1/x²) ?

questions.subskill: Recovering parameters from a horizontal asymptote and an intercept
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a(0.5)ˣ + c, where a and c are constants. As x increases, the values of f(x) get closer and closer to 6, and the graph of y = f(x) crosses the y-axis at y = 20. What is the value of f(2) ?

questions.subskill: Finding a coefficient from a factor with a fractional root
questions.stem: If 2x − 3 is a factor of 6x² + kx − 6, where k is a constant, what is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Compounding a percent change over a longer span
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a · bˣ, where a and b are positive constants. The value of f(3) is 25% less than the value of f(1). The value of f(5) is what percent less than the value of f(1) ?

questions.subskill: Difference of two constants from an identity
questions.stem: For all values of x, (x − a)² + (x − b)² = 2x² − 20x + 58, where a and b are constants and a > b. What is the value of a − b ?

questions.subskill: Building values from a difference rule
questions.stem: The function f satisfies f(x + 1) − f(x) = 4x + 6 for all values of x, and f(0) = 2. What is the value of f(3) ?

questions.subskill: Constant in a circle equation from tangency to an axis
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of x² + y² − 10x + 6y + c = 0, where c is a constant, is a circle that intersects the x-axis at exactly one point. What is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: Arc length of one sector from equal sector areas
questions.stem: Two sectors have equal areas. Sector A has a radius of 5 and a central angle of 1.6 radians. Sector B has a central angle of 0.4 radian. What is the arc length of sector B ?

questions.subskill: Angle in an isosceles triangle formed by a square and a regular pentagon
questions.stem: Square ABCD and regular pentagon ABEFG share side AB and lie on opposite sides of line AB. The square's vertices are in the order A, B, C, D, and the pentagon's vertices are in the order A, B, E, F, G, so D and G are each adjacent to A. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle ADG ?

questions.subskill: Area from similar triangles where a segment to a midpoint meets a diagonal
questions.stem: Rectangle ABCD has AB = 10 and BC = 6. Point E is the midpoint of side CD, and segment AE intersects diagonal BD at point P. What is the area of quadrilateral BCEP ?

questions.subskill: Angle in a convex kite from congruent triangles
questions.stem: In convex quadrilateral ABCD, AB = AD and CB = CD. The measure of angle BAD is 70°, and the measure of angle BCD is 50°. What is the measure of angle ABC ?

questions.subskill: Surface area of a cube with a cylindrical hole
questions.stem: A solid cube with edges of length 6 centimeters has a cylindrical hole with a radius of 2 centimeters drilled straight through it, from the center of one face to the center of the opposite face. What is the total surface area, in square centimeters, of the remaining solid, including the inside of the hole?

questions.subskill: Area of a non-isosceles trapezoid from two special right triangles
questions.stem: In trapezoid ABCD, side AB is parallel to side CD, CD = 10, and the distance between AB and CD is 6. Angle A measures 45° and angle B measures 60°, and AB is the longer base. What is the area of the trapezoid?

questions.subskill: Partly filled cone poured into a cylinder
questions.stem: A container shaped like a right circular cone, with its vertex pointing down, has a base radius of 6 centimeters and a height of 9 centimeters. It holds water to a depth of 6 centimeters. All of the water is poured into an empty right circular cylinder with a base radius of 6 centimeters. What is the depth of the water in the cylinder, in centimeters?

questions.subskill: Shared height of triangles between parallel lines
questions.stem: Lines ℓ and m are parallel. Points A and B lie on line ℓ with AB = 10, and points C and D lie on line m with CD = 14. Triangle ABC has an area of 35. What is the area of triangle ACD ?

questions.subskill: Least price meeting a profit target after a commission
questions.stem: A gallery keeps 35% of the sale price of each painting it sells, and the artist receives the rest. An artist's materials cost $40 per painting. What is the least whole-dollar sale price for which the artist's profit on a painting (the amount the artist receives minus the cost of materials) is at least $250 ?

questions.subskill: Speed from a gear ratio, a circumference and unit conversions
questions.stem: On a bicycle, the chain connects a front gear with 48 teeth to a rear gear with 16 teeth, and the rear gear turns with the rear wheel; the chain moves the same number of teeth past each gear. A cyclist turns the front gear at 80 revolutions per minute, and the rear wheel's circumference is 2.1 meters. What is the bicycle's speed, in kilometers per hour?

questions.subskill: One part of a three-term ratio, divided into containers
questions.stem: A concrete mix is made from cement, sand, and gravel in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 by volume. Cement is sold in bags that each hold 0.035 cubic meter. Assuming the volumes of the ingredients add, what is the least number of bags of cement needed to make 4.5 cubic meters of the mix?

questions.subskill: Nonresponse in a random-sample survey
questions.stem: A city mailed a survey about a proposed bike lane to 2,000 households selected at random from all the households in the city. Of these, 340 households returned the survey, and most of the returned surveys opposed the bike lane. Which statement is most appropriate?

choices.A: The results can be generalized to all households in the city, because the households were selected at random.
choices.B: The results can be generalized to all households in the city, because 340 households is a large enough sample.
choices.C: The results may not represent all households in the city, because 2,000 households is too small a part of the city.
choices.D: The results may not represent all households in the city, because the households that returned the survey may differ from those that did not.

questions.subskill: Constants from a no-solution condition and a related solution
questions.stem: In the equation 5(x − a) = bx + 15, a and b are constants, and the equation has no solution. The equation 5(x − a) = (b + 1)x + 15 has the solution x = 6. What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Identity condition from two score-adjustment procedures
questions.stem: Ms. Ruiz adjusts each raw test score s to 0.8s + 20. Mr. Lee instead adds k points to each raw score and then multiplies the result by 0.8. For what value of k do the two methods give the same adjusted score for every raw score?

questions.subskill: Interpreting a coefficient nested in a product of two inputs
questions.stem: A community center charges C dollars to rent its hall for h hours for an event with p guests, where C = 150 + h(40 + 2p). What is the best interpretation of 2 in this context?

choices.A: The amount, in dollars, by which the hourly charge increases for each additional guest
choices.B: The amount, in dollars, charged for each guest for the entire event, regardless of its length
choices.C: The amount, in dollars, by which the total charge increases for each additional hour
choices.D: The amount, in dollars, charged per hour for the hall when there are no guests

questions.subskill: Percent requirement with the unknown in the base
questions.stem: A farmers market requires that at least 60% of its vendors sell locally grown food. This season the market has approved 15 vendors who sell other goods. What is the least number of local-food vendors the market must have?

questions.subskill: Round-trip battery limit with different rates on each leg
questions.stem: A delivery drone flies at 0.8 kilometer per minute. While carrying a package, it uses 3% of its full battery charge per minute, and without a package it uses 2% per minute. It leaves fully charged, flies straight to a customer with a package, leaves the package, and flies straight back. It must return with at least 20% of its charge. What is the greatest possible distance, in kilometers, from the base to the customer?

questions.subskill: Working back through a tiered price from a bill ratio
questions.stem: A city charges for water at $3.00 per 1,000 gallons for the first 5,000 gallons used in a month and $5.00 per 1,000 gallons for usage beyond 5,000 gallons; partial thousands are billed proportionally. One household used 8,000 gallons in a month. A second household's bill for the month was exactly twice the first household's bill. How many gallons did the second household use?

questions.subskill: Two-purchase system with a percent discount on one item
questions.stem: At a hardware store, 3 boxes of nails and 2 boxes of screws cost $25.50. During a sale in which screws are 20% off and nails are full price, 3 boxes of nails and 5 boxes of screws cost $39.00. What is the regular price of a box of screws?

questions.subskill: Constant that makes two equations share a solution
questions.stem: The equations 5x − 8 = 2x + k and 4x + k = 27, where k is a constant, have the same solution. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Last score needed under a weighted course grade
questions.stem: A course grade is 70% of the test average plus 30% of the homework average. Kai's homework average is 92, and his average on the first 3 of 4 equally weighted tests is 78. What is the least score Kai can earn on the fourth test to get a course grade of at least 85 ?

questions.subskill: Break-even sales between a plan with and without a threshold
questions.stem: A salesperson can choose between two monthly pay plans. Plan A pays $2,400 plus 3% of all sales. Plan B pays $2,000 plus 7% of the amount of sales above $10,000. What is the least amount of monthly sales, in dollars, for which plan B pays at least as much as plan A ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting the slope of a difference function
questions.stem: Hiker A starts at an elevation of 1,500 meters and descends at 12 meters per minute; hiker B starts at 900 meters and descends at 4 meters per minute. While both are descending, the difference between their elevations t minutes after they start is D = 600 − 8t. What is the best interpretation of 8 in this context?

choices.A: The number of meters per minute by which the difference between the hikers' elevations decreases
choices.B: The number of meters per minute by which the difference between the hikers' elevations increases
choices.C: The number of meters per minute the two hikers descend combined
choices.D: The number of minutes until the hikers are at the same elevation

questions.subskill: Random assignment undone by a confounding variable
questions.stem: Researchers randomly assigned 40 of 80 tomato seedlings to receive a new fertilizer, and the other 40 received none. To keep the treatments separate, all fertilized seedlings were grown in greenhouse 1 and all the others in greenhouse 2. The fertilized seedlings produced significantly more fruit on average. Which conclusion is most appropriate?

choices.A: The increase cannot be attributed to the fertilizer, because the fertilizer's effect cannot be separated from the effect of the greenhouse.
choices.B: The increase cannot be attributed to the fertilizer, because the seedlings were not selected at random from all tomato plants.
choices.C: The fertilizer caused the increase, because growing the groups in separate greenhouses kept the treatments from mixing.
choices.D: The fertilizer caused the increase, because the seedlings were randomly assigned to receive it.

questions.subskill: Mass of one component from a volume ratio and two densities
questions.stem: An epoxy is made by mixing resin and hardener in the ratio 2 : 1 by volume. The resin has a density of 1.15 grams per milliliter, and the hardener has a density of 0.95 gram per milliliter. How many grams of hardener should be mixed with 230 grams of resin?

questions.subskill: Conditional percent within a complement of a two-stage chain
questions.stem: A gardener plants seeds. Of the seeds, 75% germinate, and of the seeds that germinate, 80% survive to be transplanted. Of the seeds that do not survive to be transplanted (including those that never germinate), what percent never germinated? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Before-and-after comparison without a control group
questions.stem: A school started a new reading program in September. The mean score of its eighth graders on the state reading test was 68 the spring before the program began and 74 the spring after. Which is the best reason this result does not show that the program caused the increase?

choices.A: The increase of 6 points is too small to show that the program had any effect at all.
choices.B: The students were not selected at random from all of the eighth graders in the state.
choices.C: The mean is affected by extreme scores, so the medians should have been compared instead.
choices.D: Without a comparison group, other differences between the two years could explain the rise.

questions.subskill: Self-selected large sample versus small random sample
questions.stem: A TV station invited viewers to vote on its website about whether the city should build a new stadium; 12,400 people voted, and 71% voted yes. A polling firm surveyed 600 city residents selected at random; 48% said yes, with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. Which conclusion is most appropriate?

choices.A: It is plausible that about 71% of city residents support the stadium, because the website vote had far more participants.
choices.B: It is plausible that between about 44% and 52% of city residents support the stadium, because the poll used a random sample.
choices.C: It is plausible that about 59.5% of city residents support the stadium, because that is the mean of the two results.
choices.D: No plausible estimate can be made, because the two results differ by more than the poll's margin of error.

questions.subskill: Allocating a total by two different rules
questions.stem: Three roommates share a monthly rent of $2,160. They split 40% of the rent equally for the shared space and split the rest in proportion to the areas of their bedrooms, which are 14, 12, and 10 square meters. How much does the roommate with the 14-square-meter bedroom pay each month?

questions.subskill: Standard deviation of two combined groups
questions.stem: Section 1 of a course has 25 students whose test scores have a mean of 70 and a standard deviation of 4. Section 2 has 25 students whose scores on the same test have a mean of 80 and a standard deviation of 4. Which statement about the standard deviation of all 50 scores is true?

choices.D: It cannot be determined from the information given.

questions.subskill: Total percent change weighted by share, not by count
questions.stem: Last year a shop earned all its revenue from 40 products, and its 10 premium products accounted for 60% of that revenue. This year, revenue from the premium products increased by 10%, and revenue from the other 30 products decreased by 5%. By what percent did the shop's total revenue change?

questions.subskill: Print width from an aspect ratio and a pixel count
questions.stem: A digital camera takes photos with an aspect ratio of 3 : 2 (width to height) and a total of 24 million pixels. If a photo is printed at 300 pixels per inch, what is the width of the print, in inches?

questions.subskill: Effect on mean and median of adding values equal to the median
questions.stem: The 99 homes sold in a town last year had a mean price of $400,000 and a median price of $350,000. This year, 21 new homes, each priced at $350,000, were added to the data set. Compared with the original 99 prices, which is true of the 120 prices?

choices.A: The mean and the median both decrease.
choices.B: The mean decreases, and the median stays the same.
choices.C: The mean stays the same, and the median decreases.
choices.D: The mean and the median both stay the same.

questions.subskill: Difference of residuals from differences in data
questions.stem: For a group of workers, the line of best fit y = 1.6x + 18 relates a worker's hourly wage y, in dollars, to the worker's years of experience x. Worker A has 5 more years of experience than worker B and earns $2 more per hour. What is worker A's residual minus worker B's residual?

questions.subskill: Shared zero of two quadratics found by subtracting
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = x² − 7x + k and y = x² − 10x + 2k, where k is a positive constant, intersect at a point on the x-axis. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Distance between solutions of a perfect-square equation
questions.stem: In the equation 9x² − 6ax + a² = 36, a is a constant. The equation has two solutions, p and q, with p > q. What is the value of p − q ?

questions.subskill: Third zero of a cubic from its constant and leading coefficients
questions.stem: The polynomial p is defined by p(x) = 3x³ + ax² + bx + 120, where a and b are constants. Two of the zeros of p are 2 and −4. What is the third zero of p ?

questions.subskill: Composing a reflection and a translation of a graph
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x − 2)(x − 5). The graph of y = g(x) is obtained by reflecting the graph of y = f(x) across the y-axis and then translating the result 3 units to the right. What are the zeros of g ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting the period of a shifted exponential cooling model
questions.stem: The temperature of a bowl of soup, in degrees Fahrenheit, t minutes after it is served is modeled by T(t) = 70 + 110(0.5)^(t/20). Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 20 in this context?

choices.A: Every 20 minutes, the amount by which the soup's temperature exceeds 70°F is cut in half.
choices.B: Every 20 minutes, the soup's temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit, is cut in half.
choices.C: Every 20 minutes, the soup's temperature drops by another 55 degrees Fahrenheit.
choices.D: Exactly 20 minutes after it is served, the soup's temperature is 70°F.

questions.subskill: Remainder of a polynomial built from a shifted input
questions.stem: When the polynomial p(x) is divided by x − 3, the remainder is 4. The polynomial q is defined by q(x) = x · p(x + 1) + 5. What is the remainder when q(x) is divided by x − 2 ?

questions.subskill: Rational equation with an excluded root
questions.stem: What is the solution set of x/(x − 2) + 3/(x + 1) = 6/(x² − x − 2) ?

questions.subskill: Constant term after shifting both solutions
questions.stem: The solutions of x² + bx + c = 0, where b and c are constants, are each 3 greater than the solutions of x² − 5x + 2 = 0. What is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting a coefficient in an average-cost model
questions.stem: A workshop's average cost per item, in dollars, of producing x items is C(x) = (2x + 600)/x. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 2 in this context?

choices.A: It costs $2 to set up production before any items are made.
choices.B: Each additional item produced adds $2 to the total cost.
choices.C: The average cost per item decreases by $2 for each additional item produced.
choices.D: When 2 items are produced, the average cost per item is $600.

questions.subskill: Greatest squared distance from the origin to a point on a circle
questions.stem: The point (a, b) lies on the circle (x − 3)² + (y − 4)² = 4 in the xy-plane. What is the greatest possible value of a² + b² ?

questions.subskill: Y-intercept of a line from the sine of its angle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line passes through the point (−2, 0) and makes an acute angle θ with the positive x-axis, where sin θ = 5/13. What is the y-intercept of the line?

questions.subskill: Trapezoid height from similar triangles formed by extended legs
questions.stem: In trapezoid ABCD, side AB is parallel to side CD, AB = 16, and CD = 12. When legs AD and BC are extended beyond D and C, they meet at point E, which is 9 units from line CD. What is the distance between lines AB and CD ?

questions.subskill: Surface area of a composite solid needing a slant height
questions.stem: A solid is made by attaching a square pyramid to a cube with edges of length 10 centimeters. The base of the pyramid is exactly one face of the cube, and the pyramid's top vertex is 12 centimeters directly above the center of that face. What is the total surface area of the solid, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Radius of a circle through two points and tangent to a line
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle passes through the points (0, 0) and (12, 0) and is tangent to the line y = 9. What is the radius of the circle?

questions.subskill: Arc length from a chord cut by a horizontal line
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = 5 intersects the circle x² + y² = 100 at points P and Q. The length of minor arc PQ is kπ. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Vertex coordinate from a right angle using perpendicular slopes
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the points A(0, 0), B(6, 2), and C(k, 11) are the vertices of a triangle in which angle ABC is a right angle. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Swing angle in degrees from arc length
questions.stem: A pendulum is 45 centimeters long. As it swings from one side to the other, its tip travels along a circular arc of length 12π centimeters. Through how many degrees does the pendulum swing?

questions.subskill: Exponential decay worked backward from two later values
questions.stem: A machine's value decreases by the same percent each year. Two years after it was purchased, its value was $40,500, and four years after it was purchased, its value was $32,805. What was the machine's value, in dollars, when it was purchased?

questions.subskill: Hidden zero of a cubic with no constant term
questions.stem: The polynomial p is defined by p(x) = x³ + bx² + cx, where b and c are constants. One zero of p is 2, and p(1) = −6. What is the value of p(−1) ?

questions.subskill: Area of a triangle formed by a line, a parabola, and the origin
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = x + 2 intersects the parabola y = x² at points A and B. If O is the origin, what is the area of triangle OAB ?

questions.subskill: Sum of solutions of an absolute value equation
questions.stem: What is the sum of all solutions to the equation |x − 3| + |x + 5| = 10 ?

questions.subskill: Intersection of a parabola and a sloped line in context
questions.stem: A garden hose sprays water up a sloped lawn. In a vertical cross section, with x and y in meters measured horizontally and vertically from the nozzle, the stream follows y = −0.05x² + 2x and the surface of the lawn follows y = 0.5x. How many meters from the nozzle, measured horizontally, does the water hit the lawn?

questions.subskill: Exterior angle bisector parallel to a side
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle A is 50°. Point D lies on the extension of side AC beyond C, and the bisector of angle BCD is parallel to side AB. What is the measure of angle ACB ?

questions.subskill: Inscribed angles from equal chords
questions.stem: Points A, B, C, and D lie on a circle in that order, so that ABCD is a convex quadrilateral. AB = BC = CD, and the measure of angle ADC is 70°. What is the measure of angle ABD ?

questions.subskill: Longer diagonal of a parallelogram
questions.stem: A parallelogram has sides of lengths 5 and 3, and one of its angles measures 60°. What is the length of the longer diagonal of the parallelogram?

questions.subskill: Areas of triangles on opposite sides of a square
questions.stem: Point P lies inside square ABCD, which has sides of length 10. The area of triangle PAB is 18. What is the area of triangle PCD ?

questions.subskill: Circle tangent to two parallel lines
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle is tangent to the lines y = 1 and y = 11 and passes through the point (2, 9). The center of the circle lies in Quadrant I. The equation of the circle can be written as x² + y² + ax + by + c = 0, where a, b, and c are constants. What is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: Counting isosceles triangles with a fixed perimeter
questions.stem: How many different triangles with integer side lengths and a perimeter of 30 have at least two sides of equal length? (Triangles with the same three side lengths are considered the same triangle.)

questions.subskill: Order of a vertical shift and a vertical stretch
questions.stem: For a function f, the graph of y = g(x) is obtained by translating the graph of y = f(x) up 4 units and then multiplying the y-coordinate of every point of the result by 3. The graph of y = h(x) is obtained by first multiplying every y-coordinate of the graph of y = f(x) by 3 and then translating the result up 4 units. For every x, what is the value of g(x) − h(x) ?

questions.subskill: Maximum of a quadratic model from three values
questions.stem: The height h(t), in meters, of a model rocket t seconds after launch is a quadratic function of t. The rocket's height was 51 meters at t = 2, 61 meters at t = 3, and 61 meters at t = 4. What was the rocket's maximum height, in meters?

questions.subskill: Combining exponential growth and decay factors
questions.stem: A culture of bacteria is treated with a drug. The number of bacteria t hours after treatment begins is modeled by N(t) = 500 · 2^(t/4) · (1/2)^(t/12). Which of the following best describes how N changes over time?

questions.subskill: Factor of a composed polynomial
questions.stem: The function p is a polynomial, and p(3) = 0. Which of the following must be a factor of the polynomial q(x) = p(2x − 1) ?

questions.subskill: Comparing values of a quadratic by distance from the axis
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax² + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants and a > 0. If f(2) = f(6), which of the following must be true?

questions.subskill: Exponential approach to a limit
questions.stem: A student's typing speed W, in words per minute, t weeks after starting a typing course is modeled by W(t) = 60 − a · b^t, where a and b are positive constants. If W(0) = 20 and W(3) = 40, what is the value of W(6) ?

questions.subskill: Counting solutions of a radical equation with a parameter
questions.stem: In the equation √(x + k) = x, k is a constant. For which of the following values of k does the equation have exactly two real solutions?

questions.subskill: Exactly one solution of a rational equation
questions.stem: In the equation k/(x − 2) = x, k is a constant. Which of the following lists all values of k for which the equation has exactly one real solution?
